title.zh-CN: 胸痛伴气促 · 52岁女性（术后第3天）
title.en: Chest pain and breathlessness · 52-year-old woman (post-op day 3)

summary.zh-CN: 外科病房呼叫：一位因结肠癌行开腹右半结肠切除术后第3天的52岁女性，下床行走时突发右侧胸痛和气促。到床旁评估、稳定病情、明确诊断，并在术后早期做出安全的处理决策。
summary.en: Surgical ward call: a 52-year-old woman on day 3 after an open right hemicolectomy for colon cancer develops sudden right-sided chest pain and breathlessness while walking. Assess and stabilise her at the bedside, establish the diagnosis, and make safe management decisions in the early post-operative period.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在床旁识别术后急性肺栓塞（突发胸膜性胸痛、气促、心动过速、低氧伴单侧小腿肿胀），立即给氧至SpO2 94–98%并接上持续监护。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise post-operative PE at the bedside — sudden pleuritic pain, breathlessness, tachycardia and hypoxaemia with a swollen calf — and start oxygen to SpO2 94–98% with continuous monitoring.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 计算Wells评分（10分）和修订Geneva评分（16分）；临床可能性为“很可能”时，不查D-二聚体，直接行CTPA。
learningOutcomes.en: Calculate the Wells (10) and revised Geneva (16) scores and, with PE likely, go straight to CTPA without a D-dimer.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 临床可能性高时，在快速评估出血风险（切口、出血史、送检血常规和凝血、通知外科）后、影像结果出来前即开始胃肠外抗凝，并说明术后早期选择普通肝素或低分子肝素的理由。
learningOutcomes.en: Start parenteral anticoagulation before imaging when clinical probability is high, after a rapid bleeding-risk check (wound, bleeding history, baseline blood count and clotting, surgeons informed), and justify the choice of UFH or LMWH early after surgery.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按ESC 2019顺序（血流动力学 → PESI/sPESI → 右心室影像与肌钙蛋白）进行早期死亡风险分层，并将她判定为中高危。
learningOutcomes.en: Stratify early mortality risk in the ESC 2019 order (haemodynamics → PESI/sPESI → RV imaging and troponin) and classify her as intermediate-high.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 制定监护与升级计划：转入HDU/ICU监护48–72小时、通知PERT、不行全身溶栓（3周内大手术），恶化时经导管介入或外科取栓补救再灌注。
learningOutcomes.en: Plan monitored care and escalation: HDU/ICU for 48–72 hours, the PERT alerted, no systemic thrombolysis (major surgery within 3 weeks), and catheter-directed or surgical rescue reperfusion if she deteriorates.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 避免急性右心室压力负荷过重时的有害反射：快速大量补液、利尿、硝酸酯、NSAID或阿司匹林、术后早期口服DOAC、血栓侧肢体气压治疗及无指征的下腔静脉滤器。
learningOutcomes.en: Avoid harmful reflexes in acute RV pressure overload: large fluid boluses, diuretics, nitrates, NSAIDs or aspirin, an early oral DOAC, IPC on the thrombosed leg and an unindicated IVC filter.

notes.zh-CN: 虚构的合成教学病例，依据ESC 2019急性肺栓塞指南、CHEST 2021、ASH 2020及中国2018《肺血栓栓塞症诊治与预防指南》编写；人物、时间和数值均为虚构，不对应任何真实患者。
notes.en: Fictional synthetic teaching case written to the ESC 2019 acute PE guideline, CHEST 2021, ASH 2020 and the 2018 Chinese PTE guideline; the person, timeline and values are invented and do not correspond to any real patient.

guidelines: CHEST 2021 antithrombotic therapy for VTE (second update)
中华医学会呼吸病学分会 肺血栓栓塞症诊治与预防指南（2018）
ACCP 2012 (9th ed.) VTE prevention in non-orthopaedic surgical patients

notes.zh-CN: 人工智能辅助编写，并对照所引指南进行了编辑审核；尚未经执业医师审核，用于教学前请由该专科的临床医生审核。
notes.en: AI-assisted authoring and editorial review against the cited guidance; not yet reviewed by a licensed clinician — have a clinician of the specialty review it before teaching use.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 虚构教学病例，不构成医疗建议。
disclaimer.en: Fictional teaching case — not medical advice.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 下床行走时突发右侧胸痛、气促20分钟
chiefComplaint.en: Sudden right-sided chest pain and breathlessness for 20 minutes, starting while walking

triageNote.zh-CN: 外科病房呼叫：52岁女性，开腹右半结肠切除术后第3天。16:00左右从厕所走回病床途中突发右侧胸痛伴气促，扶住扶手未摔倒。16:10护士测：心率118次/分，血压112/70 mmHg，呼吸26次/分，SpO2 89%（未吸氧），体温37.4 ℃。
triageNote.en: Surgical ward call: 52-year-old woman, day 3 after open right hemicolectomy. At about 16:00, walking back from the toilet, she developed sudden right-sided chest pain and breathlessness; she grabbed the handrail and did not fall. Nurse's obs at 16:10: HR 118/min, BP 112/70 mmHg, RR 26/min, SpO2 89% on room air, T 37.4 °C.

personality.zh-CN: 务实、能干，平时习惯照顾别人；此刻非常害怕，但尽力配合医生。
personality.en: Practical and capable, used to looking after other people; frightened right now but trying hard to cooperate.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 普通话，用词通俗；因气促只能说短句，常停下来喘气；不用医学术语，药名只记得降压药。
speechStyle.en: Plain everyday language; breathless, so short phrases with pauses; no medical jargon, and she only remembers the name of her blood-pressure tablet.

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生……我右边胸口……突然好痛……喘不上气……
openingLine.en: Doctor... right side of my chest... suddenly... so painful... can't get my breath...

concerns.zh-CN: 是不是癌症扩散到肺里了？
concerns.en: Has the cancer spread to my lungs?

concerns.zh-CN: 女儿今晚要来，别吓着她。
concerns.en: My daughter is coming tonight — I don't want to frighten her.

actingNotes.zh-CN: 明显气促：每次只说三到六个字就停下来喘气；深吸气时皱眉并用手按住右下胸；焦虑，不时看向身边的医护人员和仪器。医生解释清楚、给予安慰后情绪稍平复；吸氧和镇痛后说话可以稍长一些。绝不自行说出检查结果或诊断。
actingNotes.en: Clearly breathless: three to six words, then a pause for breath; winces and presses the lower right chest on deep inspiration; anxious, keeps looking round at the staff and the equipment. Settles a little when things are explained and she is reassured; can manage slightly longer sentences after oxygen and analgesia. Never volunteers test results or a diagnosis.

label.zh-CN: 术后第3天 · 外科病房

description.zh-CN: 16:20，外科病房床旁。模拟时钟：每项操作消耗模拟时间，检查结果需要等待。
description.en: 16:20 at the bedside on the surgical ward. Simulated clock: every action takes simulated time and results take time to come back.

question.zh-CN: 哪里不舒服？发生了什么？
question.en: What's happened — what's troubling you?

answer.zh-CN: 医生……我右边胸口……突然好痛，喘不上气……
answer.en: Doctor... right side of my chest... sudden pain... I can't get my breath...

question.zh-CN: 什么时候开始的？是突然发生的吗？当时在做什么？
question.en: When did it start, was it sudden, and what were you doing at the time?

answer.zh-CN: 就二十分钟前……大概四点。我从厕所走回病床，走到走廊一半……一下子就痛了，马上就喘不上来。之前一点预兆都没有。
answer.en: About twenty minutes ago... around four. I was walking back from the toilet, halfway down the corridor... it hit me all at once, and straight away I couldn't breathe. No warning at all.

question.zh-CN: 具体哪里痛？痛会往别的地方放射吗？
question.en: Where exactly is the pain, and does it spread anywhere?

answer.zh-CN: 这里……右边胸口下面，靠后背一点。不往肩膀、胳膊、脖子或者下巴那边走。
answer.en: Here... lower right chest, a bit towards the back. It doesn't go into my shoulder, arm, neck or jaw.

question.zh-CN: 是什么样的痛？深呼吸或咳嗽时会加重吗？
question.en: What is the pain like — is it worse when you breathe in or cough?

answer.zh-CN: 像刀扎一样，尖尖的……一直在痛，一吸气、一咳嗽就更痛。坐着别动、小口小口地喘，会好一点。
answer.en: Sharp, like a knife... it's there all the time, but worse every time I breathe in or cough. Keeping still and taking little breaths helps a bit.

question.zh-CN: 如果0分是不痛、10分是最痛，现在有几分？
question.en: On a scale of 0 to 10, how bad is the pain?

answer.zh-CN: 大概6分……吸气的时候有7分。
answer.en: About six... seven when I breathe in.

question.zh-CN: 肚子或者刀口痛不痛？和前两天比怎么样？
question.en: Any tummy pain — how is the wound pain compared with the last couple of days?

answer.zh-CN: 刀口一动、一咳嗽就有点痛，跟手术后这几天差不多，吃了止痛药还能忍，今天没有更厉害。胸口这个痛完全不一样。
answer.en: The cut hurts a bit when I move or cough — about the same as since the operation, and the painkillers keep it bearable. It's no worse today. This chest pain is completely different.

source.zh-CN: 合成病例；与切口查体（预期内的切口周围压痛）和用药记录一致。
source.en: Synthetic; consistent with the wound examination (expected peri-incisional tenderness) and the medication chart.

question.zh-CN: 气促有多严重？坐着休息也喘吗？
question.en: How breathless are you — even sitting still?

answer.zh-CN: 坐着……也喘。说话……说不了一整句。
answer.en: Even sitting... I'm breathless. Can't... finish a sentence.

question.zh-CN: 有没有晕倒、眼前发黑或者头晕？
question.en: Did you faint, black out or feel light-headed?

answer.zh-CN: 刚痛的时候……眼前发灰，我赶紧抓住扶手。没有摔倒，也没有晕过去，没碰到头。
answer.en: When it started... everything went grey and I grabbed the handrail. I didn't fall or pass out, and I didn't hit my head.

question.zh-CN: 有没有心慌、心跳很快？
question.en: Any palpitations or a racing heart?

answer.zh-CN: 有……心跳得咚咚的，很快。
answer.en: Yes... my heart's pounding, really fast.

question.zh-CN: 有没有咳血或者痰里带血？
question.en: Have you coughed up any blood?

answer.zh-CN: 没有血……就是有点干咳。
answer.en: No blood... just a little dry cough.

question.zh-CN: 有没有发烧、怕冷、寒战，或者咳黄痰？
question.en: Any fever, chills or coloured phlegm?

answer.zh-CN: 没有咳痰。早上护士说我有一点点低烧，但没有发冷打颤。
answer.en: No phlegm. The nurse said this morning I was a little warm, but I haven't had chills or shivers.

question.zh-CN: 腿有没有疼痛或肿胀？
question.en: Any pain or swelling in your legs?

answer.zh-CN: 您这么一问……右边小腿从昨天白天就有点胀痛、发紧，我以为是躺久了。左腿没事。
answer.en: Now you mention it... my right calf has ached and felt tight since yesterday, during the day. I thought it was from lying in bed. The left one's fine.

question.zh-CN: 术后到今天之前，有没有过类似的气促或胸痛？
question.en: Before today, had you noticed any breathlessness or chest pain since the operation?

answer.zh-CN: 昨天傍晚下床坐到椅子上、走了几步，就有点喘，歇一会就好了，我以为是手术后没力气。胸口以前没痛过。
answer.en: Yesterday evening, getting out to the chair and taking a few steps, I got a bit puffed; it settled after a rest and I put it down to the operation. No chest pain before today.

question.zh-CN: 手术后您下床活动多吗？
question.en: How mobile have you been since the operation?

answer.zh-CN: 头两天基本都躺在床上，昨天康复师扶我坐到椅子上。今天下午是第一次自己走到走廊那头的厕所。
answer.en: The first two days I was mostly in bed. Yesterday the physio got me sitting out in a chair. This afternoon was the first time I walked to the toilet down the corridor on my own.

question.zh-CN: 术后每天有没有打预防血栓的针（肚皮上打的抗凝针）？昨天打了吗？
question.en: Have you been getting a daily blood-thinning injection in your tummy since the operation — did you have it yesterday?

answer.zh-CN: 肚皮上那个针？头两个晚上都打了。昨天晚上护士说刀口有点渗液，医生交代先停一次，所以昨晚没打。
answer.en: The one in my tummy? I had it the first two nights. Last night the nurse said the wound was weeping a bit and the doctor wanted it held, so I didn't have it.

question.zh-CN: 做的是什么手术？什么时候做的？
question.en: What operation did you have, and when?

answer.zh-CN: 三天前上午做的……医生说是开腹，把右边的一段肠子切掉了，因为长了肿瘤。肚子上一条长刀口。
answer.en: Three days ago, in the morning... they opened my tummy and took out part of the bowel on the right side because of a tumour. I've got a long cut down my belly.

question.zh-CN: 以前还做过别的手术吗？
question.en: Have you had any other operations before?

answer.zh-CN: 没有，这是我第一次做手术。
answer.en: No — this is the first operation I've ever had.

question.zh-CN: 肿瘤是几期？病理结果出来了吗？
question.en: What stage is the cancer — are the final pathology results back?

answer.zh-CN: 医生还没告诉我最后的结果……我也不知道是几期。
answer.en: The doctors haven't told me the final result yet... I don't know the stage.

question.zh-CN: 关于肿瘤，医生是怎么跟您说的？
question.en: What have you been told about the tumour?

answer.zh-CN: 上个月老觉得累、没力气，一查说是贫血，大便化验有隐血，做肠镜发现的，说是结肠癌。手术前给我输了补铁的针，还做过增强CT，医生说没看到转移到别的地方。切下来的东西化验结果还没出来。没做过化疗，也没做过放疗。
answer.en: Last month I was tired all the time — they said I was anaemic and found hidden blood in my stool, and the colonoscopy found it — bowel cancer. Before the operation they gave me an iron drip and did a contrast CT, and said they couldn't see any spread. The lab results on what they removed aren't back yet. I haven't had any chemo or radiotherapy.

question.zh-CN: 有没有穿弹力袜，或者用腿部气压治疗？
question.en: Have you been wearing compression stockings or using leg pumps?

answer.zh-CN: 手术前给我穿了很紧的长袜子，太勒了，手术后第二天我就脱掉了，后来没再穿。腿上打气的那种机器没用过。
answer.en: They put tight stockings on me before the operation — too tight, so I took them off on the second day after the operation and haven't worn them since. I've never had a leg-pump machine.

question.zh-CN: 您平时吃什么药？住院后在用什么药？
question.en: What medicines do you take at home, and what are you on in hospital?

answer.zh-CN: 在家只吃氨氯地平，5毫克，一天一次，降血压的。住院后护士说降压药先停了。现在按时吃对乙酰氨基酚，痛得厉害时再加一片止痛片，中午十二点多吃过一次。还有肚皮上那个针。
answer.en: At home just amlodipine 5 mg once a day for blood pressure. Since the operation the nurse said that's on hold. Now I get paracetamol regularly, plus a stronger painkiller tablet when it's bad — I had one just after twelve. And the injection in my tummy.

question.zh-CN: 有没有用过激素替代治疗或避孕药？还来月经吗？
question.en: Any hormone replacement or the contraceptive pill? Are you still having periods?

answer.zh-CN: 从来没用过激素，也没吃过避孕药。两年前就绝经了。只怀过一次孕，就是我女儿，顺产，没流过产。
answer.en: I've never taken hormones or the pill. My periods stopped two years ago. I've had one pregnancy — my daughter, a normal delivery — and no miscarriages.

question.zh-CN: 有没有药物或造影剂过敏？
question.en: Any allergies to medicines or contrast dye?

answer.zh-CN: 没有已知的过敏。上个月做增强CT打了造影剂，也没什么反应。
answer.en: No allergies that I know of. I had contrast dye for a CT scan last month with no reaction.

question.zh-CN: 以前有什么疾病吗？心脏、肺、糖尿病？
question.en: Any other medical problems — heart, lungs, diabetes?

answer.zh-CN: 就是高血压，大概五年了，吃一种药控制得挺好。没有心脏病、肺病、哮喘，也没有糖尿病；肾和肝也没听说有什么问题。
answer.en: Only high blood pressure for about five years, well controlled on one tablet. No heart or lung disease, no asthma, no diabetes, and no kidney or liver trouble that I know of.

question.zh-CN: 以前有没有得过血栓，比如腿上的静脉血栓或者肺里的血栓？
question.en: Have you ever had a blood clot in your legs or lungs before?

answer.zh-CN: 没有，从来没有过。
answer.en: No, never.

question.zh-CN: 有没有出血方面的问题？比如胃溃疡、出血性疾病、刀口出血、黑便或者呕血？
question.en: Any bleeding problems — stomach ulcers, a bleeding disorder, bleeding from the wound, black stools or vomiting blood?

answer.zh-CN: 没有胃溃疡，也从来没有出血止不住的毛病。昨天刀口有点渗湿纱布，护士说今天已经干了。没有吐过血。手术后还没解大便，所以不知道颜色。
answer.en: No ulcers, and I've never had trouble with bleeding. Yesterday the wound wet the dressing a little; the nurse says it's dry today. I haven't vomited blood. I haven't opened my bowels since the operation, so I can't say about the colour.

question.zh-CN: 以前有没有中风、脑出血、头部外伤或者脑部肿瘤？
question.en: Have you ever had a stroke, brain bleed, head injury or brain tumour?

answer.zh-CN: 都没有。
answer.en: No, none of those.

question.zh-CN: 现在能吃东西喝水吗？排气、排便了吗？有没有恶心呕吐？
question.en: Are you eating and drinking? Have you passed wind or opened your bowels? Any nausea or vomiting?

answer.zh-CN: 昨天开始喝点水、喝点米汤。今天早上放屁了，还没解大便。不恶心，也没吐。
answer.en: Since yesterday I've been sipping water and a little rice soup. I passed wind this morning but haven't opened my bowels. No nausea, no vomiting.

question.zh-CN: 尿管拔了以后，小便怎么样？
question.en: Have you passed urine since the catheter came out?

answer.zh-CN: 早上八点拔的尿管。之后小便解了几次，开始是护士扶我用便盆，今天下午才第一次自己走去厕所。不疼，也不费劲。
answer.en: They took the tube out at eight this morning. I've passed water a few times since — on a bedpan with the nurse at first; this afternoon was the first time I walked to the toilet myself. No burning, no trouble.

source.zh-CN: 合成病例；与护士交班（08:00拔除导尿管）一致。
source.en: Synthetic; consistent with the nurse's handover (urinary catheter removed at 08:00).

question.zh-CN: 这次生病前您的活动能力怎么样？平躺时会不会憋气，脚踝会不会肿？
question.en: Before all this, what was your exercise tolerance like? Any breathlessness lying flat or swollen ankles?

answer.zh-CN: 以前我爬四楼都不用歇。平躺不憋气，脚也从来不肿。
answer.en: I used to climb four flights of stairs without stopping. No trouble lying flat, and my feet have never swollen.

question.zh-CN: 您抽烟吗？
question.en: Do you smoke?

answer.zh-CN: 不抽，从来没抽过。
answer.en: No, never have.

question.zh-CN: 您喝酒吗？
question.en: Do you drink alcohol?

answer.zh-CN: 基本不喝，过年喝一小杯。
answer.en: Hardly ever — a small glass at New Year.

question.zh-CN: 有没有用过毒品或者其他娱乐性药物？
question.en: Do you use any recreational drugs?

answer.zh-CN: 没有，从来没碰过。
answer.en: No — never.

question.zh-CN: 您做什么工作？和谁一起住？
question.en: What do you do for work, and who do you live with?

answer.zh-CN: 我在一所小学做会计。和丈夫一起住，女儿在外地读大学，今晚坐车过来看我。
answer.en: I'm an accountant at a primary school. I live with my husband; our daughter's at university in another city and she's coming to see me tonight.

question.zh-CN: 最近有没有长途旅行，比如长时间坐飞机或者火车？
question.en: Any recent long-distance travel — long flights or train journeys?

answer.zh-CN: 没有，手术前我一直在本地，哪儿也没去。
answer.en: No, I've been at home locally — I haven't been anywhere.

question.zh-CN: 家里人有没有得过血栓或者其他大病？
question.en: Any blood clots or serious illnesses in your family?

answer.zh-CN: 就我所知，家里没人得过血栓。我妈妈有高血压，我爸爸78岁时中风去世了。
answer.en: Not that I know of — nobody with clots. My mum has high blood pressure; my dad died of a stroke at 78.

question.zh-CN: 您的体重和身高是多少？
question.en: What are your weight and height?

answer.zh-CN: 手术前称的是70公斤，身高1米62。
answer.en: They weighed me before the operation — 70 kilos. I'm 1 metre 62.

question.zh-CN: 最近体重有没有下降？晚上会不会出虚汗？
question.en: Have you lost any weight recently, or had night sweats?

answer.zh-CN: 没怎么瘦……体重一直差不多。晚上也不出虚汗。
answer.en: Not really... my weight's stayed about the same. No night sweats.

question.zh-CN: 您现在最担心的是什么？
question.en: What are you most worried about right now?

answer.zh-CN: 是不是心脏出问题了？……还是癌细胞跑到肺里了？我女儿今晚要来，别吓着她。
answer.en: Is it my heart?... Or has the cancer got into my lungs? My daughter's coming tonight — I don't want to frighten her.

question.zh-CN: 您希望我们为您做些什么？
question.en: What are you hoping we can do for you?

answer.zh-CN: 就想能喘上气……千万别再让我做一次手术。
answer.en: I just want to be able to breathe... please don't let me need another operation.

question.zh-CN: 以前有没有查过易栓症（容易长血栓的体质）？
question.en: Have you ever been tested for a clotting disorder (thrombophilia)?

answer.zh-CN: 这个……我没听说过，不知道有没有查过。
answer.en: Hmm... I've never heard of that — I don't know if I've been tested.

question.zh-CN: 以前做过心脏彩超吗？
question.en: Have you ever had a heart ultrasound (echocardiogram)?

answer.zh-CN: 好像没做过……记不清了。
answer.en: I don't think so... I can't remember.

finding.zh-CN: 焦虑，在床上挺直坐着，呼吸浅快，只能说短句；面色苍白，额头微汗；未见明显发绀。左前臂留置针在位、通畅。
finding.en: Anxious, sitting bolt upright, breathing fast and shallow, speaking in short phrases; pale with a slightly clammy forehead; no obvious cyanosis. Peripheral cannula in the left forearm, patent.

maneuver.en: Inspect the conjunctivae, lips and tongue

finding.zh-CN: 结膜轻度苍白；口唇略暗，舌无发绀；口腔黏膜湿润。
finding.en: Mild conjunctival pallor; lips slightly dusky, tongue not cyanosed; mucous membranes moist.

finding.zh-CN: 颈静脉压升高，约胸骨角上4 cm，搏动明显。
finding.en: JVP raised, about 4 cm above the sternal angle, with prominent pulsation.

maneuver.en: Inspect, palpate and percuss the chest

finding.zh-CN: 呼吸浅快；右下胸因疼痛呼吸动度略减低（夹板样呼吸）；无胸廓畸形；右肺底叩诊稍浊，其余肺野叩诊清音。
finding.en: Rapid, shallow breathing; expansion slightly reduced at the right base because of pain (splinting); no chest-wall deformity; percussion slightly dull at the right base, resonant elsewhere.

finding.zh-CN: 右肺底呼吸音减低；双肺底少许细湿啰音，深呼吸后部分消失；右下侧胸部可闻及轻微胸膜摩擦音；无哮鸣音。
finding.en: Reduced breath sounds at the right base; a few fine basal crackles bilaterally that partly clear after deep breaths; a faint pleural rub over the right lower lateral chest; no wheeze.

finding.zh-CN: 心率快，律齐；P2亢进（第二心音肺动脉瓣成分增强）；未闻及杂音、奔马律或心包摩擦音。
finding.en: Tachycardic, regular rhythm; loud P2 (accentuated pulmonary component of the second heart sound); no murmur, gallop or pericardial rub.

finding.zh-CN: 可触及轻度胸骨左缘抬举样搏动；心尖搏动位置正常；无震颤。
finding.en: Subtle left parasternal heave; apex beat undisplaced; no thrills.

finding.zh-CN: 四肢末梢温暖，毛细血管再充盈时间2秒；无杵状指，无外周发绀；桡动脉搏动规则、有力，双侧对称。
finding.en: Peripheries warm, capillary refill 2 s; no clubbing or peripheral cyanosis; radial pulses regular, of good volume and symmetrical.

maneuver.zh-CN: 检查双下肢（测量小腿周径，沿深静脉走行触诊）
maneuver.en: Examine both legs (measure calf circumference, palpate along the deep veins)

finding.zh-CN: 右小腿肿胀：胫骨结节下10 cm处周径右38.0 cm、左35.0 cm（相差3.0 cm）；沿右腘窝及小腿深静脉走行有压痛；右踝轻度凹陷性水肿；无红斑，皮温无明显升高。左下肢未见异常。
finding.en: Right calf swollen: circumference 10 cm below the tibial tuberosity 38.0 cm right vs 35.0 cm left (3.0 cm difference); tenderness along the deep veins of the right popliteal fossa and calf; mild pitting oedema of the right ankle; no erythema or obvious warmth. Left leg normal.

finding.zh-CN: 腹部轻度膨隆，软；切口周围轻压痛，与术后相符；无反跳痛、肌紧张。正中切口长约18 cm，皮钉在位，敷料今日已更换，仅见少量陈旧淡黄色渗液痕迹，无新鲜出血、无血肿、无红肿。肠鸣音存在，偏弱。无腹腔引流管。
finding.en: Mildly distended, soft; tender around the incision as expected after surgery; no guarding or rebound. 18 cm midline wound with clips; dressing changed today with only a small old serous stain — no fresh bleeding, haematoma or erythema. Bowel sounds present but quiet. No abdominal drain.

finding.zh-CN: 神志清楚，GCS 15（E4V5M6），定向力正常；双侧瞳孔等大等圆、对光反射灵敏；四肢肌力对称，无局灶性神经体征。
finding.en: Alert and oriented, GCS 15 (E4V5M6); pupils equal and reactive; symmetrical limb power; no focal neurological signs.

maneuver.zh-CN: 皮肤检查（瘀斑、出血点、注射部位）
maneuver.en: Inspect the skin (bruising, petechiae, injection sites)

finding.zh-CN: 腹壁原注射部位有几处小瘀斑；未见出血点或紫癜；留置针穿刺处无渗血。
finding.en: A few small bruises at the abdominal injection sites; no petechiae or purpura; no oozing at the cannula site.

maneuver.zh-CN: 按压胸壁，看能否诱发疼痛
maneuver.en: Palpate the chest wall for reproducible tenderness

finding.zh-CN: 按压胸壁及肋软骨不能诱发或加重胸痛。
finding.en: Pressing on the chest wall and costal cartilages does not reproduce the pain.

examNotRecorded.zh-CN: 本病例未记录该项检查的结果。
examNotRecorded.en: This examination is not recorded for this case.

text.zh-CN: 窦性心动过速，118次/分；电轴+95°（轻度右偏）；PR 150 ms，QRS 112 ms（V1呈rSR′，不完全性右束支传导阻滞），QTc 446 ms；I导联深S波，III导联Q波伴T波倒置（S1Q3T3）；V1–V3 T波倒置；无ST段抬高。与4周前术前心电图（窦性心律72次/分，正常心电图）比较，S1Q3T3、不完全性右束支传导阻滞及V1–V3 T波倒置均为新出现。
text.en: Sinus tachycardia 118/min; axis +95° (mild right axis deviation); PR 150 ms, QRS 112 ms (rSR′ in V1, incomplete right bundle branch block), QTc 446 ms; deep S wave in lead I, Q wave with T-wave inversion in lead III (S1Q3T3); T-wave inversion V1–V3; no ST elevation. Compared with the pre-operative ECG 4 weeks ago (sinus rhythm 72/min, normal ECG), the S1Q3T3 pattern, incomplete RBBB and V1–V3 T-wave inversion are new.

text.zh-CN: 采样条件：未吸氧（空气，FiO2 0.21），16:15由责任护士按病区快速反应流程采集，并立即上机检测。pH 7.47，PaCO2 4.1 kPa（31 mmHg），PaO2 7.5 kPa（56 mmHg），HCO3⁻ 22 mmol/L，BE −1.0 mmol/L，SaO2 89%，乳酸1.9 mmol/L。计算值：肺泡-动脉氧分压差（A–a）约7.3 kPa（55 mmHg）；按年龄预计上限约2.3 kPa（17 mmHg）。
text.en: Sampling conditions: room air (FiO2 0.21), drawn at 16:15 by the ward nurse under the ward rapid-response protocol and analysed straight away. pH 7.47, PaCO2 4.1 kPa (31 mmHg), PaO2 7.5 kPa (56 mmHg), HCO3⁻ 22 mmol/L, BE −1.0 mmol/L, SaO2 89%, lactate 1.9 mmol/L. Calculated: alveolar–arterial (A–a) gradient ≈ 7.3 kPa (55 mmHg); age-predicted upper limit ≈ 2.3 kPa (17 mmHg).

note.zh-CN: 该标本为呼叫医生前、未吸氧时采集，反映吸氧前的状态。
note.en: This sample was drawn before you arrived, on room air, and reflects her state before oxygen.

text.zh-CN: 白细胞轻度升高，以中性粒细胞为主；血红蛋白112 g/L（术前126 g/L，术后第1天114 g/L）；血小板238×10⁹/L（术前262×10⁹/L）。
text.en: Mild neutrophil-predominant leucocytosis; haemoglobin 112 g/L (pre-op 126 g/L, POD1 114 g/L); platelets 238×10⁹/L (pre-op 262×10⁹/L).

text.zh-CN: PT、INR及APTT正常；纤维蛋白原轻度升高（术后急性期反应）。
text.en: PT, INR and APTT normal; fibrinogen mildly raised (post-operative acute-phase response).

analyte.zh-CN: 活化部分凝血活酶时间

text.zh-CN: 电解质正常；阴离子间隙11 mmol/L［138 −（104 + 23）］；尿素4.6 mmol/L，肌酐68 µmol/L，eGFR（CKD-EPI 2021）93 mL/min/1.73 m²；随机血糖6.4 mmol/L；白蛋白32 g/L（偏低）。
text.en: Electrolytes normal; anion gap 11 mmol/L [138 − (104 + 23)]; urea 4.6 mmol/L, creatinine 68 µmol/L, eGFR (CKD-EPI 2021) 93 mL/min/1.73 m²; random glucose 6.4 mmol/L; albumin 32 g/L (low).

text.zh-CN: hs-cTnT 68 ng/L（第99百分位上限14 ng/L），升高。
text.en: hs-cTnT 68 ng/L (99th-percentile upper reference limit 14 ng/L) — raised.

text.zh-CN: NT-proBNP 1850 ng/L（参考值<125 ng/L），升高。
text.en: NT-proBNP 1,850 ng/L (reference < 125 ng/L) — raised.

text.zh-CN: D-二聚体6.8 mg/L FEU（参考值<0.5 mg/L FEU），明显升高。
text.en: D-dimer 6.8 mg/L FEU (reference < 0.5 mg/L FEU) — markedly raised.

note.zh-CN: 大手术后数天内D-二聚体几乎总是升高，阳性结果特异性很低；临床可能性为“很可能”时，阴性结果也不足以排除诊断。
note.en: D-dimer is almost always raised in the days after major surgery, so a positive result is very non-specific; when clinical probability is 'likely', even a negative result would not be enough to exclude the diagnosis.

text.zh-CN: CRP 86 mg/L（术后第1天142 mg/L），较前下降。
text.en: CRP 86 mg/L (POD1 142 mg/L) — falling.

text.zh-CN: A型，RhD阳性；不规则抗体筛查阴性；标本72小时内有效。
text.en: Group A, RhD positive; antibody screen negative; sample valid for 72 hours.

text.zh-CN: 毛细血管血糖6.4 mmol/L。
text.en: Capillary glucose 6.4 mmol/L.

text.zh-CN: 床旁前后位半卧位胸片：右侧膈肌轻度抬高；双肺底线状（盘状）肺不张；右侧肋膈角变钝，提示少量胸腔积液；未见气胸；未见局灶性实变；前后位片上心影大小在正常范围；无肺水肿征象。
text.en: Portable AP semi-erect film: mildly elevated right hemidiaphragm; bibasal linear (plate) atelectasis; blunted right costophrenic angle suggesting a small effusion; no pneumothorax; no focal consolidation; heart size within normal limits for an AP film; no features of pulmonary oedema.

text.zh-CN: CT肺动脉造影（护士携监护仪陪同完成）：双侧急性肺动脉栓塞——右肺动脉主干远段充盈缺损，延伸至右上、中、下叶肺动脉；左下叶肺动脉及其多个段分支充盈缺损；未见骑跨栓。右心室扩大，轴位右心室/左心室横径比1.3，室间隔变直并向左心室侧膨出，造影剂少量反流入下腔静脉。右下叶后基底段胸膜下楔形实变影，符合早期肺梗死；右侧少量胸腔积液；双肺底亚段性肺不张。未见气胸，其余肺野未见实变。扫描范围内上腹部仅见术后改变。
text.en: CT pulmonary angiography (performed with a nurse and monitor escort): bilateral acute pulmonary emboli — filling defects in the distal right main pulmonary artery extending into the right upper, middle and lower lobar arteries, and in the left lower lobe artery and several of its segmental branches; no saddle embolus. Dilated right ventricle with an axial RV/LV diameter ratio of 1.3, straightening and leftward bowing of the interventricular septum, and mild reflux of contrast into the IVC. Wedge-shaped subpleural opacity in the posterior basal segment of the right lower lobe consistent with early pulmonary infarction; small right pleural effusion; bibasal subsegmental atelectasis. No pneumothorax; no consolidation elsewhere. Included upper abdomen: post-operative changes only.

note.zh-CN: 危急值：放射科已电话通知病区。
note.en: Critical result: radiology has phoned the ward.

text.zh-CN: 右心室扩大（基底段RV/LV横径比1.1），右心室游离壁运动减低而心尖段运动保留（McConnell征）；胸骨旁短轴见室间隔变平、左心室呈“D”字形；TAPSE 14 mm；三尖瓣反流峰速3.1 m/s（峰压差38 mmHg）；下腔静脉内径2.0 cm、吸气塌陷率<50%，估测右房压8 mmHg，估测肺动脉收缩压约46 mmHg；左心室偏小、收缩增强，目测LVEF约65%；无心包积液；右心内未见游离血栓；未见明显瓣膜病变。
text.en: Dilated right ventricle (basal RV/LV diameter ratio 1.1) with RV free-wall hypokinesia and apical sparing (McConnell sign); septal flattening with a 'D-shaped' LV in parasternal short axis; TAPSE 14 mm; TR peak velocity 3.1 m/s (peak gradient 38 mmHg); IVC 2.0 cm with < 50% inspiratory collapse, estimated RA pressure 8 mmHg, estimated PA systolic pressure ≈ 46 mmHg; small, hyperdynamic LV, visual LVEF ≈ 65%; no pericardial effusion; no right-heart thrombus in transit; no significant valve disease.

text.zh-CN: 右侧：腘静脉、胫后静脉及腓静脉管腔内低回声充填，探头加压不能压瘪，彩色血流充盈缺损——符合急性深静脉血栓（近端达腘静脉）；股总静脉及股静脉可完全压闭，血流呈期相性。左侧：股总静脉、股静脉及腘静脉均可完全压闭，未见血栓。
text.en: Right: the popliteal, posterior tibial and peroneal veins contain hypoechoic thrombus, are non-compressible and show colour-flow filling defects — consistent with acute deep-vein thrombosis extending proximally to the popliteal vein; common femoral and femoral veins fully compressible with phasic flow. Left: common femoral, femoral and popliteal veins fully compressible; no thrombus.

name.zh-CN: 用药执行记录与护理记录
name.en: Medication administration record and nursing chart

text.zh-CN: 体重（术前）70 kg，身高162 cm。依诺肝素40 mg（4000 IU）皮下注射，每日20:00：术后第0天20:00已执行；术后第1天20:00已执行；术后第2天20:00“暂停——切口少量渗液，待外科复评”，未执行；此后无外科复评记录，医嘱仍处于暂停状态，今日（术后第3天）20:00的剂量也不会执行。抗血栓弹力袜：术后第2天患者自行脱下，拒绝重新穿戴；未使用间歇充气加压装置。对乙酰氨基酚1 g口服，每6小时（今日06:00、12:00已执行）；羟考酮5 mg口服，必要时（今日12:10执行1次）；氨氯地平5 mg口服每日1次——术后暂停（收缩压110–125 mmHg）。导尿管今日08:00拔除。
text.en: Weight (pre-op) 70 kg, height 162 cm. Enoxaparin 40 mg (4,000 IU) SC daily at 20:00: POD0 20:00 given; POD1 20:00 given; POD2 20:00 'HELD — minor wound ooze, for surgical review', not given; no surgical review documented since and the order is still on hold, so today's (POD3) 20:00 dose would not be given either. Anti-embolism stockings: removed by the patient on POD2, declined refitting; no intermittent pneumatic compression in use. Paracetamol 1 g PO 6-hourly (given 06:00 and 12:00 today); oxycodone 5 mg PO as required (one dose at 12:10 today); amlodipine 5 mg PO daily — held since surgery (systolic BP 110–125 mmHg). Urinary catheter removed at 08:00 today.

text.zh-CN: 标本已送外院参考实验室，结果待回（通常需1–2周）。
text.en: Sample sent to the external reference laboratory; result pending (usually 1–2 weeks).

note.zh-CN: 急性血栓形成及肝素治疗会影响抗凝血酶、蛋白C/S及狼疮抗凝物结果；首次由手术诱发的静脉血栓栓塞一般不推荐做易栓症检测。
note.en: Acute thrombosis and heparin distort antithrombin, protein C/S and lupus anticoagulant results; testing is generally not recommended after a first surgery-provoked VTE.

text.zh-CN: 需氧及厌氧血培养各1套已送检；目前无生长报告（培养进行中，最终结果需5天）。
text.en: One aerobic and one anaerobic set sent; no growth reported so far (incubation in progress; final result at 5 days).

message.zh-CN: 提示：普通平扫CT无法显示肺动脉腔内充盈缺损；本病例的胸部CT按CT肺动脉造影（增强）完成。
message.en: Note: a non-contrast CT cannot show filling defects in the pulmonary arteries; in this case the chest CT is performed as a contrast CT pulmonary angiogram.

message.zh-CN: 提示：16:15护士已按病区快速反应流程在未吸氧状态下采集了动脉血样，此处给出的是该动脉血气结果。
message.en: Note: at 16:15 the ward nurse already drew an arterial sample on room air under the rapid-response protocol; the result shown is that arterial gas.

dose.zh-CN: 鼻导管2–4 L/min，滴定至SpO2 94–98%
dose.en: Nasal cannula 2–4 L/min, titrated to SpO2 94–98%

response.zh-CN: 护士为她接上鼻导管吸氧，按SpO2 94–98%调节流量。
response.en: The nurse fits nasal cannulae and titrates the flow to SpO2 94–98%.

dose.zh-CN: 储氧面罩10–15 L/min；SpO2达标后降级为鼻导管
dose.en: Reservoir mask 10–15 L/min; step down to nasal cannula once on target

response.zh-CN: 已用储氧面罩高流量吸氧。注意：达标（94–98%）后应及时降级，避免不必要的高浓度氧。
response.en: High-flow oxygen on the reservoir mask. Remember to step down once she is on target (94–98%) to avoid unnecessary high-concentration oxygen.

name.zh-CN: 持续心电、血压及血氧监护
name.en: Continuous ECG, NIBP and SpO2 monitoring

dose.zh-CN: 床旁监护仪：持续心电及血氧监测，无创血压每15分钟一次
dose.en: Bedside monitor: continuous ECG and SpO2, NIBP every 15 minutes

response.zh-CN: 监护仪已连接，报警限已设置。
response.en: Monitor attached and alarm limits set.

name.zh-CN: 建立第二条大口径静脉通路

dose.zh-CN: 18G留置针，同时抽取血标本
dose.en: 18G cannula; draw bloods at the same time

response.zh-CN: 右前臂置入18G留置针，回血通畅。
response.en: An 18G cannula is placed in the right forearm and flushes well.

name.en: Sit upright / head of bed elevated

dose.zh-CN: 床头抬高45–60°
dose.en: Head of bed 45–60°

response.zh-CN: 她坐直后说呼吸稍微顺一点。
response.en: Sitting upright, she says breathing is a little easier.

name.zh-CN: 普通肝素静脉泵入（按体重给药）

dose.zh-CN: 普通肝素80 U/kg静脉推注，随后18 U/kg/h持续泵入；6小时后查APTT（目标为对照值的1.5–2.5倍，或抗Xa 0.3–0.7 IU/mL），按院内列线图调整；每2–3天复查血小板计数
dose.en: UFH 80 U/kg IV bolus, then 18 U/kg/h infusion; APTT at 6 h (target 1.5–2.5 × control, or anti-Xa 0.3–0.7 IU/mL) and adjust per the hospital nomogram; platelet count every 2–3 days

harm.zh-CN: 叠加抗凝，或在活动性大出血时使用肝素，会显著增加致命性出血风险。
harm.en: Stacking anticoagulants, or giving heparin during active major bleeding, sharply increases the risk of life-threatening haemorrhage.

response.zh-CN: 已推注5600 U（70 kg × 80 U/kg），肝素泵按1260 U/h（18 U/kg/h）运行，护士设置6小时后复查APTT的提醒。普通肝素半衰期短（约60–90分钟），一旦出血可停泵并用鱼精蛋白完全中和。
response.en: Bolus of 5,600 U given (80 U/kg for 70 kg); the pump runs at 1,260 U/h (18 U/kg/h) and the nurse sets a 6-hour APTT reminder. UFH has a short half-life (about 60–90 min) and is fully reversible with protamine if bleeding occurs.

name.zh-CN: 依诺肝素治疗剂量皮下注射

dose.zh-CN: 依诺肝素1 mg/kg皮下注射，每12小时一次；肌酐清除率<30 mL/min时需调整（先查肌酐）
dose.en: Enoxaparin 1 mg/kg SC every 12 hours; adjust if creatinine clearance is < 30 mL/min (check the creatinine first)

harm.zh-CN: 不能叠加抗凝或在活动性出血时使用；一旦出现低血压（可能需要再灌注治疗），应改用可快速调整和中和的普通肝素静脉推注加泵入。
harm.en: Do not stack anticoagulants or give during active bleeding; once she is hypotensive (reperfusion likely), IV UFH with a bolus is recommended because it can be titrated and reversed quickly.

response.zh-CN: 已皮下注射依诺肝素70 mg（7000 IU；70 kg × 1 mg/kg）。对血流动力学稳定的患者，这是指南的默认选择；但其作用持续约12小时，鱼精蛋白仅能部分（约60%）中和，术后早期一旦出血或需补救再灌注，可控性不如普通肝素。
response.en: Enoxaparin 70 mg (7,000 IU; 1 mg/kg for 70 kg) given SC. For a haemodynamically stable patient this is the guideline default, but its effect lasts about 12 hours and protamine reverses only about 60% of it — less controllable than UFH if she bleeds early after surgery or needs rescue reperfusion.

name.zh-CN: 预防剂量依诺肝素皮下注射

dose.zh-CN: 依诺肝素40 mg（4000 IU）皮下注射，每日一次
dose.en: Enoxaparin 40 mg (4,000 IU) SC once daily

harm.zh-CN: 在已行治疗性抗凝时再加预防剂量属于重复抗凝；活动性大出血时也不能使用。两者都会增加出血风险。
harm.en: On top of therapeutic anticoagulation this is duplicate anticoagulation, and it must not be given during active major bleeding; both increase the bleeding risk.

response.zh-CN: 护士执行了注射，但小声提醒：“这是预防量，对已经出现的问题够吗？”——预防剂量不能治疗已经形成的静脉血栓栓塞。
response.en: The nurse gives the injection but asks quietly, 'That's the prevention dose — is it enough for what's happening now?' A prophylactic dose does not treat established venous thromboembolism.

dose.zh-CN: 利伐沙班15 mg口服，每日2次（21天后改为20 mg每日1次）
dose.en: Rivaroxaban 15 mg PO twice daily (then 20 mg once daily after 21 days)

harm.zh-CN: 现在不宜：结肠切除术后第3天，肠功能刚恢复，口服吸收不可靠；在血流动力学是否稳定尚需观察、可能需要补救再灌注的最初2–3天，应先用胃肠外抗凝；DOAC难以迅速逆转（本院未备特异性拮抗剂），与肝素叠加更会导致严重出血。
harm.en: Not now: on day 3 after a bowel resection oral absorption is unreliable; in the first 2–3 days, while haemodynamic stability is still being watched and rescue reperfusion may be needed, parenteral anticoagulation should come first; a DOAC cannot be reversed rapidly (no specific antidote is stocked here) and stacking it with heparin risks major bleeding.

response.zh-CN: 护士按医嘱给她服下利伐沙班15 mg。
response.en: The nurse gives rivaroxaban 15 mg as prescribed.

name.zh-CN: 全身静脉溶栓（阿替普酶）

dose.zh-CN: 阿替普酶100 mg静脉输注2小时（ESC 2019方案；中国2018指南推荐50 mg持续静脉滴注2小时）
dose.en: Alteplase 100 mg IV over 2 hours (ESC 2019 regimen; the 2018 Chinese guideline recommends 50 mg over 2 hours)

harm.zh-CN: 禁忌：开腹结肠切除术后第3天——3周内大手术是溶栓禁忌（ESC 2019列为绝对禁忌，中国2018指南等列为相对禁忌），可致切口、吻合口及颅内大出血。血压正常的患者，全身溶栓虽能减少血流动力学失代偿，却增加大出血和出血性卒中且不降低死亡率（PEITHO），不应常规使用；即使进展为高危（休克型）肺栓塞，由于存在这一禁忌，也应首选经PERT的外科取栓或导管介入治疗。
harm.en: Contraindicated: day 3 after open colectomy — major surgery within 3 weeks is a contraindication to fibrinolysis (absolute in ESC 2019; relative in some other guidance, including the 2018 Chinese guideline) and risks wound, anastomotic and intracranial haemorrhage. In a normotensive patient, systemic lysis reduces haemodynamic decompensation but increases major bleeding and haemorrhagic stroke without reducing mortality (PEITHO), so it is not used routinely; even if she progresses to high-risk (shocked) PE, this contraindication makes surgical embolectomy or catheter-directed therapy via the PE response team the preferred reperfusion.

response.zh-CN: 阿替普酶开始静脉输注。
response.en: Alteplase infusion started.

dose.zh-CN: 晶体液1000 mL，15分钟内快速输注
dose.en: Crystalloid 1,000 mL over 15 minutes

harm.zh-CN: 15分钟内快速输入1000 mL晶体液对急性右心室压力负荷过重有害：会进一步扩张右心室、使室间隔左移压迫左心室、降低心排量，可诱发或加重失代偿。先看颈静脉：颈静脉压升高说明右心充盈压并不低。即使出现低血压，也只在充盈压低时谨慎给予≤500 mL（15–30分钟）；若低血压由出血引起，应输注血液制品，而不是大量晶体液。
harm.en: A rapid 1,000 mL crystalloid bolus is harmful with an acutely pressure-loaded right ventricle: it further dilates the RV, shifts the septum into the LV and lowers cardiac output, which can precipitate or worsen decompensation. Check the JVP first: a raised JVP means right-sided filling pressure is not low. Even if she becomes hypotensive, give only cautious boluses (≤ 500 mL over 15–30 min) when filling pressures are low; if hypotension is due to bleeding, give blood products rather than large volumes of crystalloid.

response.zh-CN: 液体快速输入。
response.en: The bolus runs in.

dose.zh-CN: 呋塞米40 mg静脉推注
dose.en: Furosemide 40 mg IV

harm.zh-CN: 没有任何提示左心衰或肺水肿的依据（无端坐呼吸，无心衰病史）。术后突发气促时，颈静脉压升高更可能反映右心室急性压力负荷过重；右心室依赖前负荷，利尿减少回心血量，可诱发低血压。
harm.en: Nothing points to left-heart failure or pulmonary oedema (no orthopnoea, no heart-failure history). In sudden post-operative breathlessness a raised JVP is more likely to reflect an acutely pressure-loaded right ventricle, which is preload-dependent, so diuresis can precipitate hypotension.

response.zh-CN: 呋塞米已静脉推注。
response.en: Furosemide given IV.

dose.zh-CN: 酮咯酸30 mg静脉注射
dose.en: Ketorolac 30 mg IV

harm.zh-CN: 即将或正在进行治疗性抗凝时联用NSAID会显著增加大出血风险，术后早期还影响血小板功能和肾功能。胸膜性疼痛可用对乙酰氨基酚加小剂量阿片类药物滴定。
harm.en: NSAIDs combined with (imminent) therapeutic anticoagulation substantially increase major bleeding risk, and in the early post-operative period they also impair platelet and renal function. Use paracetamol and small titrated opioid doses for pleuritic pain.

response.zh-CN: 酮咯酸已静脉注射。
response.en: Ketorolac given IV.

dose.zh-CN: 阿司匹林300 mg嚼服
dose.en: Aspirin 300 mg PO, chewed

harm.zh-CN: 无指征：没有任何提示急性冠脉综合征的依据——她的胸痛是锐痛、随呼吸加重（胸膜性），阿司匹林并不能治疗这种情况的可能病因；开腹术后第3天加用抗血小板药只会增加出血风险，若需要抗凝则风险更高。
harm.en: Not indicated: nothing here points to an acute coronary syndrome — her pain is sharp and pleuritic — and aspirin does not treat the likely causes of this picture. Three days after a laparotomy an antiplatelet only adds bleeding risk, especially if she needs anticoagulation.

response.zh-CN: 护士给她嚼服了阿司匹林300 mg。
response.en: The nurse gives her aspirin 300 mg to chew.

dose.zh-CN: 硝酸甘油0.4–0.5 mg舌下含服（喷雾一揿或片剂一片）
dose.en: GTN 0.4–0.5 mg sublingual (one spray or one tablet)

harm.zh-CN: 无指征：她的胸痛是锐痛、随呼吸加重，并非缺血性胸痛，硝酸酯不能缓解。术后突发气促伴低氧和心动过速时，在排除之前应假定右心室可能处于急性压力负荷过重状态——右心室依赖前负荷，扩张静脉会使血压骤降。
harm.en: Not indicated: her pain is sharp and pleuritic, not ischaemic-sounding, and nitrates will not relieve it. In sudden post-operative breathlessness with hypoxaemia and tachycardia, assume the right ventricle may be acutely pressure-loaded until shown otherwise — it is preload-dependent, and venodilatation can make the blood pressure fall abruptly.

response.zh-CN: 护士给她舌下含服了硝酸甘油；几分钟后血压下降，她说有点头晕，胸痛没有缓解。
response.en: The nurse gives sublingual GTN; within a few minutes her blood pressure falls and she feels light-headed, and the chest pain is no better.

dose.zh-CN: 吗啡2.5 mg缓慢静注，必要时每5–10分钟重复，监测呼吸和血压
dose.en: Morphine 2.5 mg slow IV, repeat every 5–10 minutes as needed, monitoring RR and BP

harm.zh-CN: 低血压时阿片类药物可通过扩血管进一步降低血压，应先稳定循环。
harm.en: In hypotension, opioids can lower blood pressure further through vasodilatation — stabilise the circulation first.

response.zh-CN: 几分钟后她说吸气时的疼痛减轻了一些，能稍微深一点呼吸。
response.en: After a few minutes she says the pain on breathing in is a little easier and she can take slightly deeper breaths.

name.zh-CN: 对乙酰氨基酚静脉滴注

dose.zh-CN: 对乙酰氨基酚1 g静脉滴注15分钟，距上次给药至少4小时；24小时总量（含常规剂量）≤4 g（先核对给药记录）
dose.en: Paracetamol 1 g IV over 15 min, at least 4 h after the previous dose; max 4 g in 24 h including regular doses (check the drug chart)

response.zh-CN: 护士核对给药记录（上次12:00给药），给予对乙酰氨基酚静脉滴注，并取消18:00那次常规剂量，使24小时总量不超过4 g。镇痛作用温和——这种程度的胸膜性疼痛通常还需要小剂量阿片类药物滴定。
response.en: The nurse checks the chart (last dose at 12:00), gives IV paracetamol and cancels the 18:00 regular dose to keep the 24-hour total within 4 g. The effect is modest — pleuritic pain this severe usually also needs a small titrated opioid dose.

name.zh-CN: 去甲肾上腺素静脉泵入

dose.zh-CN: 去甲肾上腺素起始0.05 µg/kg/min，经中心静脉或近端大静脉泵入，滴定至平均动脉压≥65 mmHg
dose.en: Noradrenaline starting at 0.05 µg/kg/min via a central or proximal large-bore line, titrated to MAP ≥ 65 mmHg

harm.zh-CN: 她血压正常、灌注良好，没有休克，不需要血管活性药；在普通病房经外周静脉使用缩血管药还有外渗坏死风险。
harm.en: She is normotensive and well perfused — not shocked — so a vasopressor is not indicated; a peripheral vasopressor on a general ward also risks extravasation injury.

response.zh-CN: 去甲肾上腺素开始泵入，起始0.05 µg/kg/min（70 kg约3.5 µg/min）。
response.en: Noradrenaline infusion started at 0.05 µg/kg/min (≈ 3.5 µg/min for 70 kg).

name.zh-CN: 补救再灌注：导管介入或外科肺动脉取栓（经PERT）
name.en: Rescue reperfusion: catheter-directed therapy or surgical embolectomy (via PERT)

dose.zh-CN: 由肺栓塞救治团队（PERT）决定：导管介入碎栓/抽吸（必要时局部低剂量溶栓），或体外循环下肺动脉切开取栓
dose.en: Per the PE response team (PERT): catheter-directed fragmentation/aspiration (± low-dose local lysis) or surgical pulmonary embolectomy on bypass

harm.zh-CN: 血流动力学稳定时不常规进行有创再灌注（ESC 2019）：这会让术后第3天的患者承担额外的出血和操作风险，却没有确定的获益。应先抗凝并密切监护，仅在恶化时作为补救。
harm.en: Routine invasive reperfusion is not recommended while she is haemodynamically stable (ESC 2019): it adds bleeding and procedural risk on post-op day 3 without proven benefit. Anticoagulate, monitor closely and keep it as rescue if she deteriorates.

response.zh-CN: PERT评估后将她送往导管室/手术室完成再灌注治疗；返回后右心负荷逐渐减轻，血压和氧合改善。
response.en: After PERT review she goes to the cath lab/theatre for reperfusion; afterwards RV strain eases and blood pressure and oxygenation improve.

dose.zh-CN: 介入科经颈内静脉或股静脉放置可回收下腔静脉滤器
dose.en: Retrievable IVC filter placed by interventional radiology via the jugular or femoral vein

harm.zh-CN: 她可以接受抗凝，滤器没有适应证：在抗凝基础上加用可回收滤器并不减少肺栓塞复发或死亡（PREPIC2），永久滤器远期还增加深静脉血栓（PREPIC 8年随访）；滤器仅用于存在抗凝绝对禁忌或充分抗凝下仍复发的患者。
harm.en: She can be anticoagulated, so a filter is not indicated: adding a retrievable filter to anticoagulation does not reduce recurrent PE or mortality (PREPIC2), and permanent filters increase late DVT (PREPIC 8-year follow-up); reserve filters for an absolute contraindication to anticoagulation or recurrence despite adequate anticoagulation.

response.zh-CN: 介入科完成了下腔静脉滤器置入。
response.en: Interventional radiology places an IVC filter.

name.zh-CN: 启动大出血预案：输注红细胞

dose.zh-CN: 立即停止正在输注的溶栓药或抗凝药；快速输注红细胞2单位（紧急O型或同型），复查血红蛋白、凝血功能和纤维蛋白原（纤维蛋白原低时补充冷沉淀）；通知外科评估切口
dose.en: Stop any lytic or anticoagulant infusion now; transfuse 2 units of red cells (emergency group O or group-specific); recheck Hb, clotting and fibrinogen (cryoprecipitate if fibrinogen is low); call the surgeons to assess the wound

harm.zh-CN: 没有输血指征：她没有活动性出血。红细胞输注用于活动性大出血或血红蛋白低于约70–80 g/L；额外的容量并无必要，还带来输血反应风险。
harm.en: No indication: she is not bleeding. Red-cell transfusion is for active major bleeding or a haemoglobin below about 70–80 g/L; the extra volume is not needed and exposes her to transfusion reactions.

response.zh-CN: 护士立即停止阿替普酶输注，快速输入2单位红细胞；外科被叫来处理切口血肿，复查血红蛋白和凝血的标本已送出。
response.en: The nurse stops the alteplase infusion and runs in 2 units of red cells; the surgeons are called to deal with the wound haematoma, and a repeat Hb and clotting screen are sent.

name.zh-CN: 双下肢间歇充气加压装置（IPC）

dose.zh-CN: 双下肢气压治疗装置持续使用
dose.en: Bilateral calf IPC sleeves, continuous

harm.zh-CN: 怀疑或已证实急性深静脉血栓的肢体禁用间歇充气加压（器械说明书及院内规范）；机械预防只是预防手段，对已发生的血栓没有治疗作用。
harm.en: IPC is contraindicated on a limb with suspected or confirmed acute DVT (device labelling and local protocols); mechanical prophylaxis is prevention only and does not treat established thrombosis.

response.zh-CN: 护士为她双下肢套上气压治疗袖套。
response.en: The nurse fits IPC sleeves to both calves.

name.zh-CN: 通知主管外科团队并讨论出血风险
name.en: Inform the surgical team and discuss bleeding risk

dose.zh-CN: 电话联系外科住院总/主刀医生，用SBAR交班
dose.en: Call the surgical chief resident/operating surgeon with an SBAR handover

response.zh-CN: 外科住院总：“手术过程顺利。如果她需要治疗性抗凝，外科这边不反对——术后这么早，我们倾向用可以快速停用和中和的普通肝素静脉泵入。如果切口出血或者出现便血，请马上通知我们。”
response.en: Surgical chief resident: 'The operation was straightforward. If she needs therapeutic anticoagulation we're happy from our side — this early after surgery we'd prefer an IV UFH infusion that can be stopped and reversed quickly. Call us straight away if there's wound bleeding or blood per rectum.'

name.zh-CN: 呼叫肺栓塞救治团队（PERT）/重症医学科会诊
name.en: Activate the PE response team (PERT) / critical-care review

dose.zh-CN: 联系由ICU、心内科、介入科及心胸外科组成的PERT，报告风险分层、出血风险和当前治疗
dose.en: Call the PERT (ICU, cardiology, interventional radiology, cardiothoracic surgery) with the risk class, bleeding risk and current treatment

response.zh-CN: PERT（ICU值班医生）到床旁接收你的交班：将持续评估血流动力学；一旦出现低血压或休克，立即启动导管介入或外科取栓；并协调监护床位。
response.en: The PERT (ICU registrar) comes to the bedside and takes your handover: they will keep reassessing her haemodynamics, go straight to catheter-directed therapy or surgical embolectomy if she becomes hypotensive or shocked, and coordinate a monitored bed.

dose.zh-CN: 持续心电、血压、血氧监测至少48–72小时；护士携监护仪及抢救设备护送
dose.en: Continuous ECG, BP and SpO2 monitoring for at least 48–72 hours; nurse escort with monitor and resuscitation kit

response.zh-CN: HDU同意接收，护士携监护仪护送她转科。
response.en: HDU accepts her and she is transferred with a monitored nurse escort.

message.zh-CN: 护士：“医生，她的血氧一直在90%以下，要不要先给她吸上氧？氧气接口就在床头。”
message.en: Nurse: 'Doctor, her sats are still below 90% — shall I put some oxygen on? The outlet is right by the bed.'

message.zh-CN: 护士：“医生，她心率越来越快，人也更喘了。您打算怎么处理？需要我准备什么药或者输液泵吗？对了，她昨晚的那针抗凝针是停掉没打的。”
message.en: Nurse: 'Doctor, her heart rate keeps climbing and she's more breathless. What's the plan — do you want any drugs or a pump ready? Oh, and her blood-thinning injection was held last night — she didn't get it.'

message.zh-CN: 护士：“抗凝药已经用上了——外科知道她要全量抗凝吗？刀口有人看过了吗？”
message.en: Nurse: 'The anticoagulant's in now — do the surgeons know she's being fully anticoagulated, and has anyone looked at her wound?'

message.zh-CN: 护士：“抗凝药已经用上了——外科知道她要全量抗凝吗？”
message.en: Nurse: 'The anticoagulant's in now — do the surgeons know she's being fully anticoagulated?'

message.zh-CN: 护士：“抗凝药已经用上了——有人问过她出血的情况、看过刀口了吗？”
message.en: Nurse: 'The anticoagulant's in now — has anyone asked her about bleeding and looked at her wound?'

message.zh-CN: 林女士突然更加气促、烦躁，皮肤湿冷，收缩压降到90 mmHg以下。护士：“医生，她血压掉下来了，人也有点迷糊！”
message.en: Ms Lin suddenly becomes more breathless and restless, cold and clammy, and her systolic BP falls below 90 mmHg. Nurse: 'Doctor, her pressure's dropping and she's getting a bit muddled!'

message.zh-CN: 上级医师赶到：“她现在是休克型（高危）肺栓塞。术后第3天，全身溶栓出血风险极高——马上呼叫PERT准备导管介入或外科取栓；同时用去甲肾上腺素维持平均动脉压≥65 mmHg，普通肝素静脉推注后持续泵入，转ICU。”
message.en: The attending arrives: 'This is now shocked, high-risk PE. Three days after a laparotomy, systemic lysis carries a huge bleeding risk — call PERT now for catheter-directed therapy or surgical embolectomy, start noradrenaline to keep MAP ≥ 65 mmHg, give IV UFH as a bolus and infusion, and get her to ICU.'

message.zh-CN: 上级医师赶到：“她已经休克了。你的工作诊断是什么？哪些床旁检查能最快帮你证实？马上呼叫上级和院内急救团队，先维持血压和氧合——同时告诉我你的依据。”
message.en: The attending arrives: 'She is in shock now. What is your working diagnosis, and which bedside tests will confirm it fastest? Call for senior help and the hospital emergency team, support her blood pressure and oxygenation — and talk me through your reasoning.'

message.zh-CN: 溶栓输注过程中，腹部切口敷料迅速被鲜血浸透，切口下出现张力性血肿；她诉腹痛加剧、头晕。护士：“医生，伤口在大出血！”
message.en: During the alteplase infusion the abdominal dressing rapidly soaks with fresh blood and a tense haematoma forms under the incision; she complains of worsening abdominal pain and dizziness. Nurse: 'Doctor, the wound is bleeding heavily!'

title.en: Assess and stabilise at the bedside

hint.zh-CN: 先处理A–B–C：SpO2 89%需要吸氧（目标94–98%）并接上持续监护；再围绕胸痛和气促问清起病方式，听诊双肺，别忘了检查双下肢。
hint.en: Start with A–B–C: an SpO2 of 89% needs oxygen (target 94–98%) and continuous monitoring; then clarify how the pain and breathlessness began, auscultate the chest — and don't forget to examine both legs.

guidance.zh-CN: 外科病房呼叫你：术后患者突发胸痛和气促。到病房床旁（氧气接口、监护仪和输液泵都在床边）做ABCDE评估并稳定病情。
guidance.en: The surgical ward has called you: a post-operative patient with sudden chest pain and breathlessness. Go to her ward bedside (oxygen outlet, monitor and infusion pump are at the bed), assess ABCDE and stabilise her.

title.zh-CN: 评估验前概率，选择诊断策略
title.en: Estimate pre-test probability and choose a diagnostic strategy

hint.zh-CN: 把危险因素串起来：什么手术、几天前做的、恶性肿瘤、制动、术后血栓预防是否真正执行（问病人，或在病历终端查看用药执行记录）、既往血栓史、咯血。先用Wells或修订Geneva评分量化临床可能性，再决定D-二聚体有没有价值。
hint.en: Join up the risk factors: which operation and when, cancer, immobility, whether post-operative thromboprophylaxis was actually given (ask the patient, or check the medication administration record on the records terminal), previous clots, haemoptysis. Quantify clinical probability with the Wells or revised Geneva score before deciding whether a D-dimer adds anything.

guidance.zh-CN: 问清危险因素，估计临床可能性，然后在会诊板上选择诊断策略。
guidance.en: Establish the risk factors, estimate clinical probability, then choose a diagnostic strategy on the board.

title.zh-CN: 权衡出血风险，开始治疗
title.en: Weigh bleeding risk and start treatment

hint.zh-CN: 临床可能性高、又没有绝对禁忌时，不必等影像结果就应开始治疗。先快速评估出血风险（切口、出血史、送检血常规和凝血、通知外科），再选择术后早期最可控的方案。
hint.en: When clinical probability is high and there is no absolute contraindication, treatment should start before imaging comes back. Make a quick bleeding-risk check (wound, bleeding history, blood count and clotting sent, surgeons informed), then choose the most controllable regimen for the early post-operative period.

guidance.zh-CN: 送检基线化验，评估出血风险，在会诊板上选定方案并开始治疗。
guidance.en: Send baseline bloods, assess bleeding risk, choose a regimen on the board and start treatment.

title.zh-CN: 明确诊断并进行风险分层
title.en: Confirm the diagnosis and stratify risk

hint.zh-CN: 影像确诊后按顺序分层：①是否血流动力学不稳定；②PESI/sPESI；③右心室功能（CTPA或超声心动图）；④肌钙蛋白。
hint.en: Once imaging confirms the diagnosis, stratify in order: (1) haemodynamic instability? (2) PESI/sPESI; (3) RV function on CTPA or echo; (4) troponin.

guidance.zh-CN: 开出确诊影像和心肌损伤标志物检查，等结果时守在患者身边，结果出来后阅读报告，再到会诊板上给出风险分层。
guidance.en: Order the confirmatory imaging and cardiac biomarker, stay with the patient while the results come back, read the reports, then give the risk class on the board.

hint.zh-CN: 目前血压正常的患者早期仍可能失代偿——结合她的右心评估和生物标志物结果：她应该在哪里监护？谁需要知道？如果血压下降，术后第3天哪些再灌注方式可行？
hint.en: A patient who is normotensive now can still decompensate early — weigh what her RV assessment and biomarkers show: where should she be monitored, who needs to know, and if her blood pressure falls, which reperfusion options are feasible on post-op day 3?

guidance.zh-CN: 在会诊板上确定后续处理方案，并安排合适的监护床位。
guidance.en: Settle the ongoing management plan on the board and arrange an appropriately monitored bed.

prompt.zh-CN: 完成初步病史和体格检查后，下一步最合适的诊断策略是？
prompt.en: Having completed your initial history and examination, what is the most appropriate diagnostic strategy?

need.zh-CN: 先询问手术情况和咯血史，并检查双下肢。
need.en: First ask about the operation and haemoptysis, and examine both legs.

text.zh-CN: 先查D-二聚体，阳性再做CTPA
text.en: D-dimer first; CTPA only if it is positive

feedback.zh-CN: 不合适。Wells评分 = 深静脉血栓体征3 + 肺栓塞可能性最大3 + 心率>100次/分 1.5 + 4周内手术1.5 + 活动性恶性肿瘤1 = 10分（“很可能”，>4分）。临床可能性高时，即使D-二聚体阴性也不能排除肺栓塞；而术后第3天D-二聚体几乎必然升高。这一步只会拖延诊断。
feedback.en: Not appropriate. Wells = signs of DVT 3 + PE most likely diagnosis 3 + HR > 100 1.5 + surgery within 4 weeks 1.5 + active cancer 1 = 10 ('PE likely', > 4). With high clinical probability a negative D-dimer cannot exclude PE, and on post-op day 3 the D-dimer is almost certainly raised anyway. It only delays the diagnosis.

text.zh-CN: 临床可能性高（“PE可能”，Wells评分 > 4分）→ 直接行CTPA；若无禁忌，在等待影像期间即开始胃肠外抗凝
text.en: High clinical probability ('PE likely', Wells score > 4) → go straight to CTPA, and start parenteral anticoagulation while awaiting imaging if there is no contraindication

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。“很可能”（Wells >4；修订Geneva 16分为高度可能）时跳过D-二聚体，直接行CTPA；她上个月做增强CT未出现造影剂反应；CTPA不必等待肌酐结果，可同时送检肾功能。ESC 2019（I类，C级）建议：对高或中等临床可能性的患者，在诊断过程中即开始抗凝，前提是快速排除抗凝禁忌。
feedback.en: Correct. When PE is 'likely' (Wells > 4; revised Geneva 16 = high probability), skip the D-dimer and go straight to CTPA; she had contrast last month without a reaction, and the CTPA need not wait for the creatinine — send renal function at the same time. ESC 2019 (class I, level C) recommends starting anticoagulation during the diagnostic work-up in patients with high or intermediate clinical probability, once contraindications have been quickly excluded.

text.zh-CN: 首选核素肺通气/灌注（V/Q）显像
text.en: Ventilation/perfusion (V/Q) scan first

feedback.zh-CN: 不首选。术后肺底不张和胸腔积液会使V/Q结果多为“不能诊断”，且下班时间通常无法及时完成。V/Q主要用于造影剂过敏、严重肾功能不全或孕妇等不宜CTPA的情况。
feedback.en: Not first-line here. Post-operative basal atelectasis and effusion make a non-diagnostic V/Q result likely, and it is rarely available promptly out of hours. V/Q is mainly for contrast allergy, severe renal impairment or pregnancy.

text.zh-CN: 床旁超声心动图确诊或排除
text.en: Use bedside echocardiography to confirm or exclude the diagnosis

feedback.zh-CN: 不正确。对血流动力学稳定的患者，超声心动图既不能确诊也不能排除肺栓塞（阴性预测值低）；它用于风险分层，或在患者不稳定、无法立即做CTPA时作为床旁依据。
feedback.en: Incorrect. In a haemodynamically stable patient echocardiography can neither confirm nor exclude PE (low negative predictive value); it is used for risk stratification, or as bedside evidence when the patient is unstable and CTPA is not immediately feasible.

text.zh-CN: 不做影像，立即经验性全身溶栓
text.en: Give empirical systemic thrombolysis now without imaging

feedback.zh-CN: 错误且危险。她血压正常；溶栓只用于高危（休克型）肺栓塞，而开腹术后第3天属于溶栓禁忌。
feedback.en: Wrong and dangerous. She is normotensive; lysis is reserved for high-risk (shocked) PE, and day 3 after a laparotomy is a contraindication.

prompt.zh-CN: 需要立即开始治疗性抗凝。她是开腹右半结肠切除术后第3天，哪种初始方案最合适？
prompt.en: Therapeutic anticoagulation is needed now. She is on day 3 after an open right hemicolectomy — which initial regimen is most appropriate?

need.zh-CN: 先评估出血风险（询问出血相关病史、检查腹部切口），并弄清她术后已经用过哪些抗凝药（询问患者或查看用药执行记录）。
need.en: First assess bleeding risk (bleeding history, abdominal wound) and find out which anticoagulant doses she has already had (ask her, or check the medication administration record).

text.zh-CN: 普通肝素静脉泵入：80 U/kg推注后18 U/kg/h，6小时查APTT/抗Xa，并与外科沟通
text.en: IV unfractionated heparin: 80 U/kg bolus then 18 U/kg/h, APTT/anti-Xa at 6 h, and agree the plan with the surgeons

feedback.zh-CN: 本例最佳选择。术后早期出血风险高：普通肝素半衰期短（约60–90分钟），停泵后作用很快消失，鱼精蛋白可完全中和；剂量可随时调整，也不妨碍她万一恶化时需要的补救再灌注或再次手术。这是针对她的个体化选择——对多数需要胃肠外抗凝的患者，ESC 2019和AHA/ACC 2026均推荐低分子肝素优于普通肝素。注意：她自术后第0天起接触过低分子肝素，需监测血小板（警惕HIT）。
feedback.en: Best choice for her. Bleeding risk is high this early after surgery: UFH has a short half-life (about 60–90 min), wears off quickly when stopped and is fully reversed by protamine; it can be titrated, and it does not get in the way of rescue reperfusion or re-operation if she deteriorates. This is a patient-specific choice: for most patients who need parenteral anticoagulation, ESC 2019 and AHA/ACC 2026 recommend LMWH over UFH. Note that she has been exposed to LMWH since POD0, so monitor platelets (HIT).

text.zh-CN: 依诺肝素1 mg/kg皮下注射，每12小时一次
text.en: Enoxaparin 1 mg/kg SC every 12 hours

feedback.zh-CN: 可以接受，但不是本例最佳。对血流动力学稳定的肺栓塞，低分子肝素是指南默认选择（ESC 2019 I类A级；AHA/ACC 2026 1类推荐：大出血和HIT较少，无需监测），如果外科认为出血风险可接受也可以使用。但她术后仅第3天，心动过速、低氧，存在早期失代偿而需补救再灌注（或因出血再次手术）的现实可能；低分子肝素作用持续约12小时，鱼精蛋白只能中和约60%，最初24–72小时的可控性不如普通肝素。
feedback.en: Acceptable, but not the best choice here. For haemodynamically stable PE, LMWH is the guideline default (ESC 2019 class I, level A; AHA/ACC 2026 class 1: less major bleeding and HIT, no monitoring) and can be used if the surgeons judge the bleeding risk acceptable. But she is only 3 days post-op and tachycardic and hypoxaemic, so early decompensation needing rescue reperfusion (or re-operation for bleeding) is a real possibility; LMWH's ~12-hour effect and only ~60% reversal by protamine make it less controllable than UFH over the first 24–72 hours.

text.zh-CN: 立即口服利伐沙班15 mg，每日2次
text.en: Start oral rivaroxaban 15 mg twice daily now

feedback.zh-CN: 不合适。肠切除术后第3天，肠功能刚恢复，口服吸收不可靠；DOAC难以迅速逆转；在最初2–3天、病情可能变化的阶段应先用胃肠外抗凝。待病情稳定、进食恢复后再考虑转换为口服药（腔内消化道肿瘤患者使用部分DOAC时出血风险较高，需个体化选择）。
feedback.en: Not appropriate. On day 3 after a bowel resection oral absorption is unreliable and a DOAC cannot be reversed quickly; parenteral anticoagulation should come first during the first 2–3 days while she may still change. Consider switching to an oral agent once she is stable and eating (some DOACs carry a higher bleeding risk in luminal GI cancers, so choose individually).

text.zh-CN: 因手术出血风险暂不抗凝，先放置下腔静脉滤器，术后第7天再开始抗凝
text.en: Withhold anticoagulation because of surgical bleeding risk, insert an IVC filter and start anticoagulation on POD7

feedback.zh-CN: 错误。她没有抗凝的绝对禁忌（切口已干燥、无活动性出血、无出血性疾病史、无颅内病变）。未经治疗的肺栓塞早期死亡率高；滤器不能替代抗凝，只在存在绝对禁忌时使用。
feedback.en: Wrong. She has no absolute contraindication to anticoagulation (dry wound, no active bleeding, no bleeding disorder, no intracranial pathology). Untreated PE has a high early mortality; a filter is no substitute for anticoagulation and is only for absolute contraindications.

text.zh-CN: 恢复预防剂量依诺肝素40 mg每日一次
text.en: Resume prophylactic enoxaparin 40 mg once daily

feedback.zh-CN: 不正确。预防剂量不能治疗已形成的静脉血栓栓塞；她需要的是治疗剂量抗凝。
feedback.en: Incorrect. A prophylactic dose does not treat established venous thromboembolism; she needs therapeutic-dose anticoagulation.

prompt.zh-CN: CTPA已证实双侧肺栓塞。按ESC 2019标准，根据她就诊时（而非之后的变化）的血流动力学状态和这些检查结果，她最初的早期死亡风险分层是？
prompt.en: CTPA confirms bilateral pulmonary emboli. Using ESC 2019 criteria, her haemodynamic status at presentation (not any later change) and these results, what was her early mortality risk class at presentation?

need.zh-CN: 先阅读CTPA报告和肌钙蛋白结果。
need.en: Read the CTPA report and the troponin result first.

text.zh-CN: 高危
text.en: High risk

feedback.zh-CN: 就她就诊时的状态而言不正确。高危要求血流动力学不稳定：心搏骤停、梗阻性休克（收缩压<90 mmHg或需血管活性药，伴终末器官低灌注），或持续低血压（收缩压<90 mmHg或下降≥40 mmHg超过15分钟，且非新发心律失常、低血容量或脓毒症所致）。就诊时她血压112/70 mmHg（平均动脉压84 mmHg），神志清楚，没有休克或持续低血压。若她之后出现（或已经出现）低血压或休克，应在那时重新归为高危并进行再灌注——对她而言是经PERT行导管介入治疗或外科取栓。
feedback.en: Incorrect for her status at presentation. High risk requires haemodynamic instability: cardiac arrest, obstructive shock (SBP < 90 mmHg or vasopressors needed, with end-organ hypoperfusion) or persistent hypotension (SBP < 90 mmHg or a drop ≥ 40 mmHg for > 15 minutes, not caused by new arrhythmia, hypovolaemia or sepsis). At presentation her BP was 112/70 mmHg (MAP 84 mmHg) and she was alert, with no shock or persistent hypotension. If she becomes (or has since become) hypotensive or shocked, she is reclassified as high risk at that point and needs reperfusion — in her case catheter-directed therapy or surgical embolectomy via the PERT.

text.zh-CN: 中高危
text.en: Intermediate-high risk

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。就诊时血流动力学稳定，但PESI = 年龄52 + 肿瘤30 + 心率≥110次/分 20 + SaO2<90% 20 = 122分（IV级），sPESI = 3分（肿瘤、心率≥110次/分、SaO2<90%）；同时存在右心室功能不全（CTPA RV/LV 1.3；如做了超声心动图，还可见右心扩大、TAPSE降低）和肌钙蛋白升高（hs-cTnT 68 ng/L）——两者都阳性即为中高危。处理：抗凝，监护48–72小时，不行初始溶栓，恶化时补救再灌注。
feedback.en: Correct. At presentation she was haemodynamically stable, but PESI = age 52 + cancer 30 + HR ≥ 110 20 + SaO2 < 90% 20 = 122 (class IV) and sPESI = 3 (cancer, HR ≥ 110, SaO2 < 90%); she has both RV dysfunction (CTPA RV/LV ratio 1.3; an echo, if obtained, adds RV dilatation and a reduced TAPSE) and a raised troponin (hs-cTnT 68 ng/L) — both positive means intermediate-high. Management: anticoagulate, monitor for 48–72 hours, no primary lysis, rescue reperfusion if she deteriorates.

text.zh-CN: 中低危
text.en: Intermediate-low risk

feedback.zh-CN: 不正确。中低危是PESI III–V级或sPESI ≥1分，但右心室功能不全和肌钙蛋白升高最多只有一项阳性。她两项都阳性。
feedback.en: Incorrect. Intermediate-low means PESI class III–V or sPESI ≥ 1 with at most one of RV dysfunction or raised troponin. She has both.

text.zh-CN: 低危
text.en: Low risk

feedback.zh-CN: 不正确。低危要求PESI I–II级或sPESI 0分，且（如已评估）无右心室功能不全、肌钙蛋白不升高（低危患者可考虑早期出院）。她的PESI为122分（IV级）、sPESI为3分。
feedback.en: Incorrect. Low risk requires PESI class I–II or sPESI 0, with no RV dysfunction or raised troponin if these were assessed (such patients may be considered for early discharge). Her PESI is 122 (class IV) and sPESI is 3.

prompt.zh-CN: 按中高危肺栓塞处理时，关于她接下来的处理，以下哪些是正确的？（多选）
prompt.en: Managing her as intermediate-high-risk PE, which of the following statements about her ongoing management are correct? (Select all that apply)

text.zh-CN: 不行全身溶栓：3周内大手术是溶栓禁忌，而且血流动力学稳定时本来也没有溶栓指征
text.en: No systemic thrombolysis: major surgery within 3 weeks is a contraindication, and while she is haemodynamically stable there is no indication for it anyway

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。PEITHO研究中，中危肺栓塞全身溶栓减少了血流动力学失代偿，却增加了大出血和出血性卒中，且未降低死亡率。ESC 2019将3周内大手术列为溶栓的绝对禁忌（其他一些指南列为相对禁忌）；对危及生命的情况可以重新权衡，但她有更安全的导管介入或外科取栓作为补救。
feedback.en: Correct. In PEITHO, systemic lysis for intermediate-risk PE reduced haemodynamic decompensation but increased major bleeding and haemorrhagic stroke without reducing mortality. ESC 2019 lists major surgery within 3 weeks as an absolute contraindication (some other guidance calls it relative); contraindications can be re-weighed in an immediately life-threatening situation, but she has safer rescue options in catheter-directed therapy or surgical embolectomy.

text.zh-CN: 转入HDU/ICU，持续监护48–72小时
text.en: Transfer to HDU/ICU for continuous monitoring over the first 48–72 hours

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。中高危患者早期有失代偿风险，ESC 2019建议最初数日进行持续监护。
feedback.en: Correct. Intermediate-high-risk patients can decompensate early; ESC 2019 recommends continuous monitoring over the first days.

text.zh-CN: 如血流动力学恶化，经PERT行导管介入治疗或外科肺动脉取栓作为补救再灌注
text.en: If she deteriorates haemodynamically, use catheter-directed therapy or surgical embolectomy via the PERT as rescue reperfusion

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。ESC 2019：抗凝中出现血流动力学恶化应行补救再灌注；在溶栓禁忌或风险过高时，外科取栓或经皮导管介入治疗是替代方案。提前通知PERT可以缩短反应时间。
feedback.en: Correct. ESC 2019: haemodynamic deterioration on anticoagulation calls for rescue reperfusion; when lysis is contraindicated or too risky, surgical embolectomy or percutaneous catheter-directed treatment is the alternative. Alerting the PERT early shortens the response time.

text.zh-CN: 术后患者应常规放置下腔静脉滤器
text.en: Post-operative patients should routinely have an IVC filter

feedback.zh-CN: 错误。在抗凝基础上加用可回收滤器并不减少肺栓塞复发或死亡（PREPIC2），永久滤器远期还增加深静脉血栓（PREPIC）；滤器仅用于抗凝绝对禁忌或充分抗凝下仍复发的患者。
feedback.en: Wrong. Adding a retrievable filter to anticoagulation does not reduce recurrent PE or mortality (PREPIC2), and permanent filters increase late DVT (PREPIC); filters are only for absolute contraindications to anticoagulation or recurrence despite adequate anticoagulation.

text.zh-CN: 心动过速时给予1 L晶体液快速补液以“支持右心”
text.en: Give a rapid 1 L crystalloid bolus for the tachycardia to 'support the right heart'

feedback.zh-CN: 错误。扩张的右心室再加大量液体会加重室间隔左移、降低左心室充盈和心排量；她的心动过速反映的是右心负荷而非血容量不足，即使之后出现低血压，也只在充盈压低时谨慎补液（≤500 mL）。
feedback.en: Wrong. Loading a dilated RV with a large volume worsens septal shift and reduces LV filling and cardiac output; her tachycardia reflects RV strain, not hypovolaemia, and even if she becomes hypotensive only cautious boluses (≤ 500 mL) are given, and only when filling pressures are low.

text.zh-CN: 今晚改为口服DOAC，24小时内出院
text.en: Switch to an oral DOAC tonight and discharge within 24 hours

feedback.zh-CN: 错误。早期出院只适用于低危肺栓塞；她是中高危，又在术后早期，需要先监护和胃肠外抗凝。
feedback.en: Wrong. Early discharge is only for low-risk PE; she is intermediate-high risk and early post-operative, and needs monitoring and parenteral anticoagulation first.

text.zh-CN: 问出静脉血栓危险因素及关键阳性/阴性症状（手术、预防用药是否执行、小腿症状、晕厥、咯血、既往血栓）
text.en: Elicited VTE risk factors and key positives/negatives (surgery, whether prophylaxis was given, calf symptoms, syncope, haemoptysis, previous VTE)

text.zh-CN: 完成关键查体：双下肢、肺部和心脏听诊
text.en: Performed the key examination: legs, lung and heart auscultation

text.zh-CN: 在护士提醒前（10分钟内）给氧
text.en: Gave oxygen within 10 minutes, before the nurse had to prompt

text.zh-CN: 开始抗凝前送检血常规和凝血功能作为基线，并查肾功能
text.en: Sent a blood count and coagulation screen before anticoagulating, plus renal function

text.zh-CN: 阅读心电图、CTPA和肌钙蛋白结果
text.en: Read the ECG, CTPA and troponin results

text.zh-CN: 完成诊断检查且未做低价值检查（D-二聚体、易栓症筛查、血培养）
text.en: Completed the diagnostic work-up without low-value tests (D-dimer, thrombophilia screen, blood cultures)

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即正确进行ESC风险分层（中高危）
text.en: Classified ESC risk correctly (intermediate-high) at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 在护士提醒前及时开始治疗性抗凝
text.en: Started therapeutic anticoagulation promptly, without needing the nurse's prompt

text.zh-CN: 术后早期选择可逆、可调的普通肝素静脉泵入
text.en: Chose a reversible, titratable IV UFH infusion in the early post-operative period

text.zh-CN: 安排监护床位并通知PERT
text.en: Arranged a monitored bed and alerted the PERT

text.zh-CN: 用小剂量阿片类药物滴定缓解胸膜性疼痛
text.en: Relieved her pleuritic pain with small titrated opioid doses

text.zh-CN: 开始抗凝前评估出血风险（病史、切口）并告知外科
text.en: Assessed bleeding risk (history, wound) and informed the surgical team before anticoagulating

text.zh-CN: 以抗凝治疗为主，未对血压正常的术后早期患者行全身溶栓
text.en: Treated with anticoagulation, without systemic thrombolysis, in a normotensive early post-operative patient

text.zh-CN: 避免有害措施（快速大量补液、利尿、硝酸酯、NSAID或阿司匹林、术后早期口服DOAC、患肢气压治疗、无指征的下腔静脉滤器、溶栓相关活动性大出血时仍在抗凝）
text.en: Avoided harmful measures (large fluid bolus, diuretic, nitrate, NSAID or aspirin, early oral DOAC, IPC on the DVT limb, unindicated IVC filter, anticoagulant on board during a lytic major bleed)

text.zh-CN: 用通俗语言向患者解释病情和计划，并回应她的担忧
text.en: Explained the problem and plan in plain language and addressed her concerns

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 好的表现：确认她的担忧（心脏？癌症扩散？女儿）；用通俗语言说明“肺里的血管被血块堵住、腿上也有血块”，解释抗凝针/泵的作用和出血监测、为何要转到监护病房；不做不实承诺；邀请提问并确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance: acknowledges her concerns (heart? cancer spread? her daughter); explains in plain words that a clot is blocking blood vessels in the lungs and there is a clot in the leg; explains what the blood-thinning drip does, bleeding precautions and why she is moving to a monitored bed; makes no false promises; invites questions and checks understanding.

text.zh-CN: 与护士、外科和PERT进行清晰的闭环沟通（SBAR）
text.en: Clear, closed-loop communication with the nurse, surgeons and PERT (SBAR)

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 好的表现：给护士明确、可执行的医嘱（氧流量与目标、肝素剂量与APTT复查时间、监护频率和报警阈值）并请其复述；向外科和PERT用SBAR交班（情况、背景、评估含风险分层、建议），明确恶化时的升级流程。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance: gives the nurse specific, actionable orders (oxygen flow and target, heparin dose and APTT timing, observation frequency and escalation triggers) with read-back; hands over to the surgeons and PERT in SBAR form (situation, background, assessment including risk class, recommendation) with a clear escalation plan if she deteriorates.

knowledge.zh-CN: 交班：林雅琴，52岁，结肠癌开腹右半结肠切除术后第3天。16:00左右从厕所走回病床途中突发右侧胸痛、气促，扶住扶手未摔倒。16:10生命体征：心率118次/分，血压112/70 mmHg，呼吸26次/分，SpO2 89%（未吸氧），体温37.4 ℃。16:15按病区快速反应流程在未吸氧状态下采集了动脉血气，已立即在ICU血气分析仪上完成检测（血气标本须在采集后约30分钟内上机），开单后即可调阅结果。用药：依诺肝素40 mg每晚20:00——昨晚（术后第2天）因切口少量渗液被外科暂停，之后一直没有外科复评、也没有恢复医嘱，今晚20:00那次仍是暂停状态；弹力袜术后第2天她自己脱了，未用气压治疗；对乙酰氨基酚1 g每6小时（12:00已给），羟考酮5 mg 12:10给过一次；氨氯地平术后暂停。导尿管今早08:00拔除。术前体重70 kg。床旁有氧气接口、监护仪、输液泵；病区备有常用药（镇痛药、静脉液体、利尿剂、肝素类），其他药需向药房申领。外出做CT需要护士携带监护仪陪同。具体给药时间和剂量请学员到病历终端查看用药执行记录（MAR）。不推测诊断。
knowledge.en: Handover: Lin Yaqin, 52, day 3 after open right hemicolectomy for colon cancer. At about 16:00, walking back from the toilet, she developed sudden right-sided chest pain and breathlessness; grabbed the handrail, did not fall. Obs at 16:10: HR 118/min, BP 112/70 mmHg, RR 26/min, SpO2 89% on room air, T 37.4 °C. At 16:15, under the ward rapid-response protocol, I drew an arterial blood gas on room air — I ran it on the ICU blood-gas analyser straight away (gas samples must be analysed within about 30 minutes of sampling), and the result is released as soon as it is ordered. Medications: enoxaparin 40 mg at 20:00 nightly — last night's (POD2) dose was held by the surgeons for minor wound ooze and nobody has reviewed or restarted it since — tonight's 20:00 dose is still on hold. She took her stockings off on POD2; no IPC. Paracetamol 1 g 6-hourly (12:00 given), oxycodone 5 mg once at 12:10; amlodipine held since surgery. Urinary catheter removed at 08:00. Pre-op weight 70 kg. Oxygen outlet, monitor and infusion pumps are at the bedside; The usual ward drugs (analgesics, IV fluids, diuretics, heparins) are stocked; anything else comes from pharmacy. CT transfer needs a nurse escort with a monitor. For exact doses and times she points the learner to the medication administration record (MAR) on the records terminal. Does not speculate about the diagnosis.

knowledge.zh-CN: 可在学员已获得报告后解释胸片、CTPA和下肢静脉超声：RV/LV横径比>1.0提示右心室扩大；CTPA阳性结果按危急值电话通知病区。肾功能正常时造影剂相关肾损伤风险低（需看学员已获得的肌酐结果）。不评论报告之外的发现。
knowledge.en: Once the learner has the reports, can explain the chest film, CTPA and leg ultrasound: an RV/LV diameter ratio > 1.0 indicates RV dilatation; a positive CTPA is phoned through as a critical result. Contrast-associated kidney injury risk is low when renal function is normal (judged from the creatinine result once the learner has it). Does not comment beyond the reports.

knowledge.zh-CN: 可应要求做床旁超声心动图；在学员获得结果后解释心电图、超声心动图、肌钙蛋白和NT-proBNP：右心室功能不全的超声指标（RV/LV>1.0、TAPSE<17 mm、McConnell征、室间隔变平）。也是医院PERT成员，但只有在学员自己提出肺栓塞之后才提及。不预先透露未获得的结果。
knowledge.en: Performs a bedside echo on request; once the learner has the results, explains the ECG, echo, troponin and NT-proBNP and the echo markers of RV dysfunction (RV/LV > 1.0, TAPSE < 17 mm, McConnell sign, septal flattening). Also sits on the hospital PERT, but mentions it only once the learner has raised PE. Does not reveal results the learner has not obtained.

name.zh-CN: 外科住院总 张医生

knowledge.zh-CN: 主管外科团队成员：手术为开腹右半结肠切除术，过程顺利；术后第2天切口少量浆液性渗出，已停用一次预防性依诺肝素，之后未重新开具。从外科角度不反对治疗性抗凝，术后早期倾向使用可快速停用和中和的普通肝素静脉泵入；如有切口出血或便血需立即通知。术中出血量、吻合方式等细节本病例未记录。
knowledge.en: Member of the operating team: open right hemicolectomy, uncomplicated; minor serous wound ooze on POD2, for which one prophylactic enoxaparin dose was held and not re-prescribed. Not opposed to therapeutic anticoagulation; early after surgery prefers an IV UFH infusion that can be stopped and reversed quickly; wants to be called for any wound bleeding or blood per rectum. Intra-operative details (blood loss, anastomosis technique) are not recorded in this case.

knowledge.zh-CN: 剂量：普通肝素80 U/kg推注（70 kg = 5600 U），随后18 U/kg/h（1260 U/h），6小时查APTT（目标为对照值的1.5–2.5倍）或抗Xa 0.3–0.7 IU/mL，按院内列线图调整。依诺肝素治疗量1 mg/kg每12小时（70 mg）；仅当肌酐清除率（Cockcroft–Gault，学员拿到肌酐结果后计算）<30 mL/min时需调整。鱼精蛋白：1 mg约中和最近2–3小时内输入的100 U普通肝素（单次最大50 mg）；对依诺肝素只能中和约60%抗Xa活性。本院未备安德塞奈α，利伐沙班相关大出血使用凝血酶原复合物。自术后第0天起接触过低分子肝素，开始肝素后应每2–3天监测血小板（HIT通常在第5–10天出现）。
knowledge.en: Dosing: UFH 80 U/kg bolus (70 kg = 5,600 U) then 18 U/kg/h (1,260 U/h); APTT at 6 h (target 1.5–2.5 × control) or anti-Xa 0.3–0.7 IU/mL, adjusted per the hospital nomogram. Enoxaparin treatment dose 1 mg/kg every 12 h (70 mg); adjust only if creatinine clearance (Cockcroft–Gault, from the creatinine result once the learner has it) is < 30 mL/min. Protamine: 1 mg neutralises about 100 U of UFH given in the previous 2–3 hours (max 50 mg per dose); it neutralises only about 60% of enoxaparin's anti-Xa activity. Andexanet alfa is not stocked; rivaroxaban-associated major bleeding is managed with prothrombin complex concentrate. She has had LMWH since POD0 — monitor platelets every 2–3 days once heparin starts (HIT typically appears on days 5–10).

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教，只用提问引导，不直接给出诊断。学员自己提出静脉血栓栓塞之前，只问一般性问题（术后突发胸膜性胸痛伴低氧，有哪些危险的原因？还需要查哪里？）；之后再问：她的Wells或修订Geneva评分是多少？D-二聚体在这里有没有价值？抗凝前要排除哪些禁忌？术后早期为什么要考虑可逆性？早期死亡风险由哪些因素决定？她为什么不适合全身溶栓？如果她血压掉下来，你会叫谁、做什么？只使用学员已获得的信息。
knowledge.en: Socratic teaching — asks questions rather than giving the diagnosis. Until the learner has raised venous thromboembolism themselves, keeps questions generic (what dangerous causes of sudden pleuritic pain and hypoxaemia after surgery should you consider, and what else should you examine?); after that: What is her Wells or revised Geneva score? Does a D-dimer add anything here? Which contraindications must be excluded before anticoagulating? Why does reversibility matter early after surgery? What determines early mortality risk? Why is she not a candidate for systemic lysis? If her blood pressure falls, whom would you call and what would you do? Uses only information the learner has already obtained.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：术后急性肺栓塞（中高危）
title.en: Debrief: post-operative acute pulmonary embolism (intermediate-high risk)

conclusion.zh-CN: 诊断：结肠癌开腹右半结肠切除术后第3天发生急性双侧肺动脉栓塞，伴右侧腘静脉及小腿深静脉血栓；ESC 2019早期死亡风险为中高危（血流动力学稳定；PESI 122分IV级/sPESI 3分；CTPA及超声心动图示右心室功能不全；hs-cTnT升高）。危险因素：腹部肿瘤大手术、恶性肿瘤、术后制动；预防措施也有中断（停用一次预防性低分子肝素，弹力袜脱掉后未用其他机械预防）——但她的小腿症状在昨晚停药前已经出现，规范预防只能降低、不能消除风险。处理要点：吸氧至SpO2 94–98%；临床可能性高，跳过D-二聚体直接CTPA，并在等待影像期间开始治疗性抗凝；术后早期首选可快速停用、可完全中和的普通肝素静脉泵入（低分子肝素可接受）；转入监护床位观察48–72小时并通知PERT；不行全身溶栓（无失代偿，且3周内大手术）；一旦恶化，经PERT行导管介入或外科取栓补救再灌注。
conclusion.en: Diagnosis: acute bilateral pulmonary embolism with right popliteal and calf deep-vein thrombosis on day 3 after an open right hemicolectomy for colon cancer; ESC 2019 early mortality risk intermediate-high (haemodynamically stable; PESI 122, class IV / sPESI 3; RV dysfunction on CTPA and echo; raised hs-cTnT). Risk factors: major abdominal cancer surgery, cancer and post-operative immobility, with gaps in prophylaxis (one held LMWH dose; stockings removed and no other mechanical prophylaxis) — although her calf symptoms began before last night's held dose: prophylaxis reduces but does not abolish the risk. Key management: oxygen to SpO2 94–98%; high clinical probability, so skip the D-dimer, go straight to CTPA and start therapeutic anticoagulation while awaiting imaging; early after surgery prefer an IV UFH infusion that can be stopped quickly and fully reversed (LMWH acceptable); monitored bed for 48–72 hours with the PERT alerted; no systemic lysis (no decompensation, and major surgery within 3 weeks); if she deteriorates, rescue reperfusion by catheter-directed therapy or surgical embolectomy via the PERT.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 先估计验前概率：Wells = 3（深静脉血栓体征）+ 3（肺栓塞可能性最大）+ 1.5（心率>100次/分）+ 1.5（4周内手术）+ 1（活动性肿瘤）= 10分；修订Geneva = 2 + 2 + 3 + 5 + 4 = 16分。两者都提示“很可能/高度可能”，因此直接CTPA，D-二聚体没有价值（术后本来就升高）。
keyReasoning.en: Estimate pre-test probability first: Wells = 3 (signs of DVT) + 3 (PE most likely) + 1.5 (HR > 100) + 1.5 (surgery within 4 weeks) + 1 (active cancer) = 10; revised Geneva = 2 + 2 + 3 + 5 + 4 = 16. Both say 'likely/high', so go straight to CTPA — a D-dimer adds nothing (and is raised after surgery anyway).

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 临床可能性高且无绝对禁忌时，在影像结果出来前就开始抗凝（ESC 2019 I类）；开始前快速评估出血风险：切口、出血史、颅内病变、血红蛋白/血小板/凝血基线，并通知外科。
keyReasoning.en: With high clinical probability and no absolute contraindication, start anticoagulation before imaging returns (ESC 2019 class I) — after a quick bleeding-risk check: wound, bleeding history, intracranial pathology, baseline Hb/platelets/clotting, and the surgeons informed.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 风险分层的顺序：先看血流动力学（血压正常→非高危），再看PESI/sPESI（122分IV级/3分），最后看右心室影像和肌钙蛋白（两者均阳性）→中高危。
keyReasoning.en: Risk stratification in order: haemodynamics first (normotensive → not high risk), then PESI/sPESI (122, class IV / 3), then RV imaging and troponin (both positive) → intermediate-high.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 为什么首选普通肝素：半衰期短、可完全被鱼精蛋白中和、可随时调整，适合术后早期出血风险高且可能需要补救再灌注的患者（ESC 2019也把普通肝素主要留给可能需要再灌注、严重肾功能不全或严重肥胖的患者）；对一般血流动力学稳定的肺栓塞，低分子肝素是默认选择（ESC 2019 I类；AHA/ACC 2026 1类），本例若评估出血风险可接受，也是合理的替代方案。
keyReasoning.en: Why UFH first: short half-life, full protamine reversal and easy titration suit an early post-operative patient with high bleeding risk who may need rescue reperfusion (ESC 2019 likewise reserves UFH mainly for patients who may need reperfusion, or with severe renal impairment or severe obesity); for stable PE in general LMWH is the default (ESC 2019 class I; AHA/ACC 2026 class 1), and it is a reasonable alternative here if the bleeding risk is judged acceptable.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 为什么不溶栓：PEITHO显示中危肺栓塞全身溶栓虽减少失代偿，但增加大出血和卒中且不降低死亡率；3周内大手术是禁忌（ESC 2019为绝对禁忌）。补救首选导管介入或外科取栓。
keyReasoning.en: Why no lysis: PEITHO showed that systemic lysis in intermediate-risk PE reduces decompensation but increases major bleeding and stroke without lowering mortality; major surgery within 3 weeks is a contraindication (absolute in ESC 2019). Rescue is by catheter-directed therapy or surgical embolectomy.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 常见的有害反射：给扩张的右心室快速大量补液或利尿、联用NSAID、术后早期口服DOAC、可以抗凝却放滤器、在血栓肢体上用气压治疗。
keyReasoning.en: Harmful reflexes to avoid: large fluid boluses or diuretics for a dilated RV, adding NSAIDs, early oral DOACs after bowel surgery, filters when anticoagulation is possible, and IPC on the thrombosed limb.

boundaries.zh-CN: 本病例为虚构的单时段模拟：不涉及肝素剂量调整（APTT/抗Xa复查）、HIT的实际监测、长期抗凝方案（肿瘤相关血栓的药物选择与疗程）和出院随访；生命体征变化为教学用的简化模型。
boundaries.en: This is a fictional, single-episode simulation: it does not cover heparin titration (repeat APTT/anti-Xa), actual HIT monitoring, long-term anticoagulation (drug choice and duration for cancer-associated thrombosis) or follow-up; vital-sign changes use a simplified teaching model.

unknowns.zh-CN: 肿瘤最终病理分期尚未出结果。
unknowns.en: The final tumour pathology and stage are not yet available.

unknowns.zh-CN: 易栓症筛查结果待回（且本例不推荐检测）。
unknowns.en: The thrombophilia screen is pending (and testing is not recommended here).

unknowns.zh-CN: 既往没有超声心动图，无法比较基线右心功能。
unknowns.en: There is no previous echocardiogram to compare baseline RV function.

unknowns.zh-CN: 首次APTT/抗Xa结果及后续病程本病例未记录。
unknowns.en: The first APTT/anti-Xa result and the subsequent course are not recorded.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 腹部/盆腔恶性肿瘤大手术后静脉血栓风险很高：药物预防加机械预防，每一次停药都要有明确的复评和重新开具；指南建议此类患者延长药物预防至术后约4周（ACCP 2012，1B级）。
teachingPoints.en: VTE risk after major abdominal/pelvic cancer surgery is high: combine pharmacological and mechanical prophylaxis, make every held dose an explicit review-and-represcribe decision, and extend pharmacological prophylaxis to about 4 weeks after surgery (ACCP 2012, grade 1B).

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 肺栓塞的典型组合：突发胸膜性胸痛、气促、心动过速、低氧伴低碳酸血症/呼吸性碱中毒和A–a梯度增大；S1Q3T3特异性较高但敏感性很低，正常心电图不能排除（ESC 2019）。
teachingPoints.en: The classic PE picture: sudden pleuritic pain, breathlessness, tachycardia, hypoxaemia with hypocapnia/respiratory alkalosis and a widened A–a gradient; S1Q3T3 is fairly specific but insensitive, and a normal ECG does not exclude PE (ESC 2019).

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 给氧目标SpO2 94–98%（BTS 2017；ESC 2019：SaO2<90%时给氧）；右心衰竭时避免积极补液。
teachingPoints.en: Oxygen to a target of 94–98% (BTS 2017; ESC 2019: give oxygen if SaO2 < 90%); avoid aggressive fluids in RV failure.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: ESC 2019风险分层决定去向：高危→再灌注；中高危→抗凝+监护+补救预案；中低危→抗凝、普通病房；低危→可考虑早期出院。2026年AHA/ACC指南改用A–E临床分类，并推荐对C–E类患者进行PERT评估（1类推荐）。
teachingPoints.en: ESC 2019 risk class drives disposition: high → reperfusion; intermediate-high → anticoagulation, monitoring and a rescue plan; intermediate-low → anticoagulation on a ward; low → consider early discharge. The 2026 AHA/ACC guideline uses clinical categories A–E instead and recommends PERT assessment for categories C–E (class 1).

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 术后早期抗凝要可逆：了解普通肝素与低分子肝素的鱼精蛋白中和差异，并监测血小板（HIT）（ESC 2019）。
teachingPoints.en: Keep early post-operative anticoagulation reversible: know how protamine reverses UFH versus LMWH, and monitor platelets for HIT (ESC 2019).

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 长期计划：她的肿瘤在6个月内确诊、仍在治疗中，属于活动性肿瘤，应按肿瘤相关静脉血栓栓塞处理——至少抗凝6个月（低分子肝素，或评估消化道出血风险后选用部分DOAC），此后只要肿瘤仍处于活动期（如需辅助化疗）就继续抗凝；药物和疗程与肿瘤科共同决定（ESC 2019）。
teachingPoints.en: Long-term plan: her cancer was diagnosed within the last 6 months and is still being treated, so it counts as active and this is cancer-associated VTE — anticoagulate for at least 6 months (LMWH, or a DOAC after weighing the GI bleeding risk) and continue beyond that while the cancer remains active (e.g. during adjuvant chemotherapy); agree drug and duration with oncology (ESC 2019).
